Assistant AG Jay Jones for Attorney General. **Here’s how to vote: **WHEN: 6 AM to 7 PM on Tuesday, June 17th WHERE: At your regular polling location Don't know where to vote? You can find your polling location at the Virginia Department of Elections website **[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109713870/551997676/1384590612?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNWJlZWQwYS0wZTRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P3EIhoLPD7JBTui1k6era9aI8TMuC335qbnLMCSHo-I=&emci=a06a5415-f04a-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=f5beed0a-0e4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=18273010)**.

Dr. Lateef has served as Chairman of the Prince William County School Board, where he’s given teachers a **61% raise and increased student achievement**. He also served for eight years as Chairman of the UVA Health Systems Board, where **he spearheaded historic pay raises for nurses and tackled housing affordability in Charlottesville.** Dr. Lateef is a medical doctor, an eye surgeon, and resides in Manassas with his wife and four children.

In his previous role as an Assistant Attorney General **he took on the gun lobby to keep families safe from violent crime, sued corporate special interests to prevent higher grocery prices, and went after big banks and slumlords preying on consumers.** Jay knows that our democracy has always depended on people willing to fight for it.

| Peter,

At our 20th Anniversary Gala, we heard something powerful again and again from Vice President Kamala Harris, Secretary Deb Haaland, and Congresswoman Abigail Spanberger: _**Courage is contagious.**_ It’s showing up. It’s raising your hand when nobody else will. It’s declaring, “I might want to run,” and then doing it, even when the odds are long.

This weekend, we saw people across the country peacefully protesting, demanding justice, defending our rights, and refusing to back down.

In such a politically volatile time, it takes immense courage to speak out. And even more courage to put your name on the ballot. But that’s exactly what Emerge women are doing — every single day. Voters desperately need a " private right to action " to protect their rights. All that phrase means is that we, the people, can bring forward a lawsuit ourselves when we see wrongdoing in our elections.
These 8th Circuit decisions strip us of that -- in a world where most legal action around voting rights comes from groups like ours and our partners, not from the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ). And we've got at least these four years of DOJ's Civil Rights division facing internal attacks from a hostile presidential administration that doesn't just believe conspiracy theories, but spreads them.
There's so much at risk, Team. RUSH $25 or more right now so we have the resources we need to fight rulings like this one and protect our right to vote across the country >> [https://secure.everyaction.com/Z31SNww9Q0CZWIdx46cuSQ2]
Voter Action Project [https://secure.everyaction.com/Qyv_-_BiF0iduOUt5sZ0yw2?am=25.00&contactdata=2AShjvK7mEsGyHKCrnAwCmfe5ZnLIdxToSdewf57GDSWWVxSw4qd4V4X6srZGPzPdyB9tabh0thfxyas436SqcxKuhMcbvZTnZCSzby4KOM=]

Folks: An update from the federal 8th Circuit on one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years .
A federal appeals court recently cut off a key avenue for private groups and individuals to bring racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act (VRA). The ruling, which applies in seven states, further weakens the ability of our civil rights law to protect voters, and could lead to the Supreme Court settling the issue.
This goes back to an initial ruling from 2023, the impact of which is pretty simple to understand: That voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act. According to the 8th Circuit, and now confirmed on appeal, only the Department of Justice (DoJ) has the legal standing to sue states over voting laws.
With former Florida AG Pam Bondi -- a "big lie" spreading MAGA acolyte -- serving as Attorney General, it's clear that the DOJ is not going to protect voting rights over the next four years.
Team, we have to fight this ruling and make sure voters and advocacy groups have the right to defend voting rights in court. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can to make every vote count, either at the ballot box or in court >> [https://secure.everyaction.com/Z31SNww9Q0CZWIdx46cuSQ2]

Hi Peter,
With only a few weeks left in Oregon’s legislative session, we still have moves to make to pass the full Energy Affordability and Resilience package. These bills and investments are necessary to protect Oregonians from skyrocketing utility bills and extreme weather, like the recent heat wave. [https://secure.everyaction.com/t0-JtTIdwU6g5dqQCKv9PA2?contactdata=m5MKLHLmLwn787zZp1yUcZXdsFpMNgwrTdQDW8kQ/tNZT/liVTRJQDApJRghlpEjmIZGOfrHjNEA8VxB9CGrtaGS8QUZ1bZSogqpJ+4qxZIMo4uyfyVt+qMPB0wk/Xu4] Will you take action to push this full package across the finish line? [https://secure.everyaction.com/t0-JtTIdwU6g5dqQCKv9PA2?]
Email your legislators! [https://secure.everyaction.com/t0-JtTIdwU6g5dqQCKv9PA2?]
As an OLCV member, you've likely heard a fair amount about this package. The folks you count on at OLCV to carry out your values at the legislature have been working double-time with the Building Resilience coalition to make sure this important work is done. Just last week, the POWER Act ( HB 3546 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2025R1/Measures/Overview/HB3546?nvep=&hmac=&emci=9f7752fb-f04a-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=] ) passed to hold large, corporate electricity users accountable for their costs on our system. We have momentum now, and it's up to us to keep it up! [https://secure.everyaction.com/t0-JtTIdwU6g5dqQCKv9PA2?] Don’t let these lawmakers end this session until they pass:
* Full Funding for Climate Resilience to reinvest in three programs: * Rental Home Heat Pump Program (OR Dept. of Energy), $30m
* Community Heat Pump Deployment Program (ODOE), $15m
* Community Resilience Hubs (Office of Resilience & Emergency Management), $10m

* Fairness & Affordability in Residential (FAIR) Energy (ratemaking reform to favor consumers)
* Get the Junk Out of Rates (stop utilities from charging certain expenses like lobbying, advertising, and association fees to customers)
* Performance Based Ratemaking (modernizing how utilities profit by incentivizing performance over infrastructure investment)
* Oregon Energy Assistance Program (helps low income Oregonians pay utility bills and avoid shutoffs)
* One Stop Shop 2.0 (energy efficiency incentive navigation)
Use this tool [https://secure.everyaction.com/t0-JtTIdwU6g5dqQCKv9PA2?contactdata=m5MKLHLmLwn787zZp1yUcZXdsFpMNgwrTdQDW8kQ/tNZT/liVTRJQDApJRghlpEjmIZGOfrHjNEA8VxB9CGrtaGS8QUZ1bZSogqpJ+4qxZIMo4uyfyVt+qMPB0wk/Xu4] to email your lawmakers today and tell them they must act NOW to pass the full Energy Affordability & Resilience package.
Email your legislators! [https://secure.everyaction.com/t0-JtTIdwU6g5dqQCKv9PA2?]
Let’s keep up the pressure these final few weeks and secure these critical wins to protect Oregonians!
Onward,
Brad Reed
Campaign Director

name: Kelly Morrison
subject: Remembering my friend, Speaker Melissa Hortman
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Morrison for Congress
body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter,
I hope you are taking care of yourself after this tragic weekend for our community. I am heartbroken and horrified by the assasination of my dear friend, Speaker Emerita Melissa Hortman, and her beloved husband, Mark. Melissa was deeply revered, and loved by so many. She was kind, hard working, had a deep sense of justice and worked so hard to always do what was right. She was a true giant in Minnesota politics – someone who worked tirelessly, but always with a spark of joy and humor that made the hard work feel a little lighter for everyone around her. Melissa selflessly dedicated her life to making all of our lives better here in Minnesota – she was the epitome of a true public servant. I am thinking of and praying for the entire Hortman family, and everyone who loved them.
A memorial photo, vase of red roses, and gavel sit on Melissa Hortman's desk in the Minnesota House. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/people/hortmans-desk.jpg]
My thoughts and prayers are also with Senator John & Yvette Hoffman and their entire family. I am praying for their recovery and for their entire family.
I am also incredibly grateful for our state, local, and national law enforcement. This situation would have continued to escalate if it weren’t for the Brooklyn Park and Champlin Police bravely intervening in the series of attacks. They acted quickly and fearlessly, and undoubtedly saved lives.
I also wanted to thank everyone for the outpouring of love and kindness over the past few days. The Deephaven Police Department went above and beyond to ensure my family's safety over the weekend, and officers across the state did the same to protect my colleagues. I am so grateful for how hard our law enforcement worked to catch this assailant, and am praying for our officers as well in the aftermath of this tragedy.
Peter, we are at a watershed moment in our country’s history, and we need to all stand up together and work towards a more peaceful future. We have to be more careful about charged political rhetoric and what we choose to share – because Americans do not want to live in fear. Most Americans care about their neighbors and want them to be safe and to succeed in this country. We cannot use violent language to stoke fear in one another. It is time that we work together as Americans to ensure acts of political violence like this never happen again.
All weekend I have been thinking about Melissa and what a calm and steady leader she was. I know that she would lead in this moment with compassion and resolve, and I will continue to look to her incredible legacy for guidance.
I hope you continue to take care of yourself in the aftermath of this horrific tragedy. Please keep the Hortman and Hoffman families in your thoughts as we navigate the tough road ahead.
With gratitude, resolve, and love,
Kelly

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Justice Department Files Statement of Interest in Judicial Watch’s Lawsuit to Compel Oregon to Clean Voter Rolls
body:
Judicial Watch announced that the U.S. Department of Justice filed a statement of interest in Judicial Watch’s lawsuit that calls on Oregon’s secretary of state to make “a reasonable effort to remove” the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls as required by federal law (Judicial Watch, et al. v. The State of Oregon et al. (No. 6:24-cv-01783)). U.S. District Court Judge Michael J. McShane set a hearing in the case for June 18 at 10:00 a.m.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas DPS makes arrest after warning state lawmakers of "credible threats" tied to Capitol protest,**" Texas Tribune's**Renzo Downey** and**Ayden Runnels** - "The Texas Department of Public Safety says it has arrested one person in connection to the "credible threats" made to state lawmakers planning to attend an anti-Trump rally at the Capitol in Austin, hours after two Democratic Minnesota legislators and their spouses were shot early Saturday morning.

"A short time ago, a Trooper with the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) took one person into custody in connection with the threats made against state lawmakers who planned to attend today's protest at the Texas State Capitol Complex," DPS spokesperson **Ericka Miller** said in a statement.

DPS says there is no additional active threat.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/dd640c19-50e4-4647-99d9-d827bbdb6a47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The person was arrested after a traffic stop in La Grange. DPS confirmed [a report from The Texan](https://substack.com/redirect/4cf5f0a7-12a2-41cd-b40c-96f9370e7f77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the arrested man held far-left political views and was heading to the Capitol with the intent to harm individuals with opposing beliefs. DPS on Monday said no charges have been filed against the man in connection with the alleged threats against state lawmakers. The agency has yet to name the suspect.

Earlier Saturday, DPS had warned state lawmakers and legislative staffers of "credible threats" to legislators planning to attend the Austin "No Kings" protest.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/dd640c19-50e4-4647-99d9-d827bbdb6a47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That DPS alert was sent out just before 1 p.m., according to screenshots of emails obtained by The Texas Tribune, and a DPS spokesperson told the Tribune the Capitol was evacuated shortly after. The warning came hours before several Texas federal, state and city elected officials spoke at a protest against President **Donald Trump** in downtown Austin.

In a letter to Gov.**Greg Abbott** and DPS Director Freeman Martin around the start of the protest, Texas House Democratic Leader **Gene Wu** and 43 other members of the Democratic caucus requested updates on what steps DPS is taking to protect lawmakers and other elected officials. The caucus also said the shooting against the Minnesota lawmakers was "the direct result of years of inflammatory rhetoric, threats, and dehumanization that have turned political disagreements into insurgent violence."

"The rhetoric that has poisoned our national political discourse -- calling political opponents 'enemies of the people,' describing immigrants as 'invaders,' and urging followers to 'Fight, fight, fight,' -- has now also claimed the lives of dedicated public servants," they continued. "For years, and just like the shooting in El Paso, violent rhetoric has stoked the flames of division and resulted in tragedy."

Before DPS confirmed the arrest,**Jeffrey Clemmons** , communications director for state Sen. **Sarah Eckhardt** , told the Tribune that DPS arrested someone "who was going to agitate the protest."

Eckhardt was among the officials scheduled to speak at the Capitol protest. Other elected officials who spoke at the event include Democratic U.S. Rep. **Lloyd Doggett** and Democratic state Rep.**John Bucy III**.

Austin City Council Member **Zo Qadri** , who was also at the Capitol protest, expressed gratitude to law enforcement over the arrest.

"Everyone -- lawmakers and attendees alike -- deserves to gather and protest without fear," Qadri said in a written statement to the Tribune. "It's important to condemn the winds of hate that give rise to political violence that has been threatened in Austin today, and tragically witnessed in Minnesota this morning."" TOP NEWS "Texas DPS makes arrest after warning state lawmakers of "credible threats" tied to Capitol protest," Texas Tribune'sRenzo Downey andAyden Runnels - "The Texas Department of Public Safety says it has arrested one person in connection to the "credible threats" made to state lawmakers planning to attend an anti-Trump rally at the Capitol in Austin, hours after two Democratic Minnesota legislators and their spouses were shot early Saturday morning. "A short time ago, a Trooper with the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) took one person into custody in connection with the threats made against state lawmakers who planned to attend today's protest at the Texas State Capitol Complex," DPS spokesperson Ericka Miller said in a statement. DPS says there is no additional active threat. The person was arrested after a traffic stop in La Grange. DPS confirmed that the arrested man held far-left political views and was heading to the Capitol with the intent to harm individuals with opposing beliefs. DPS on Monday said no charges have been filed against the man in connection with the alleged threats against state lawmakers. The agency has yet to name the suspect. Earlier Saturday, DPS had warned state lawmakers and legislative staffers of "credible threats" to legislators planning to attend the Austin "No Kings" protest. That DPS alert was sent out just before 1 p.m., according to screenshots of emails obtained by The Texas Tribune, and a DPS spokesperson told the Tribune the Capitol was evacuated shortly after. The warning came hours before several Texas federal, state and city elected officials spoke at a protest against President Donald Trump in downtown Austin. In a letter to Gov.Greg Abbott and DPS Director Freeman Martin around the start of the protest, Texas House Democratic Leader Gene Wu and 43 other members of the Democratic caucus requested updates on what steps DPS is taking to protect lawmakers and other elected officials. The caucus also said the shooting against the Minnesota lawmakers was "the direct result of years of inflammatory rhetoric, threats, and dehumanization that have turned political disagreements into insurgent violence." "The rhetoric that has poisoned our national political discourse -- calling political opponents 'enemies of the people,' describing immigrants as 'invaders,' and urging followers to 'Fight, fight, fight,' -- has now also claimed the lives of dedicated public servants," they continued. "For years, and just like the shooting in El Paso, violent rhetoric has stoked the flames of division and resulted in tragedy." Before DPS confirmed the arrest,Jeffrey Clemmons , communications director for state Sen. Sarah Eckhardt , told the Tribune that DPS arrested someone "who was going to agitate the protest." Eckhardt was among the officials scheduled to speak at the Capitol protest. Other elected officials who spoke at the event include Democratic U.S. Rep. Lloyd Doggett and Democratic state Rep.John Bucy III. Austin City Council Member Zo Qadri , who was also at the Capitol protest, expressed gratitude to law enforcement over the arrest. "Everyone -- lawmakers and attendees alike -- deserves to gather and protest without fear," Qadri said in a written statement to the Tribune. "It's important to condemn the winds of hate that give rise to political violence that has been threatened in Austin today, and tragically witnessed in Minnesota this morning."" "**Texas DPS makes arrest after warning state lawmakers of "credible threats" tied to Capitol protest,**" Texas Tribune's**Renzo Downey** and**Ayden Runnels** - "The Texas Department of Public Safety says it has arrested one person in connection to the "credible threats" made to state lawmakers planning to attend an anti-Trump rally at the Capitol in Austin, hours after two Democratic Minnesota legislators and their spouses were shot early Saturday morning.

"A short time ago, a Trooper with the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) took one person into custody in connection with the threats made against state lawmakers who planned to attend today's protest at the Texas State Capitol Complex," DPS spokesperson **Ericka Miller** said in a statement.

DPS says there is no additional active threat.

The person was arrested after a traffic stop in La Grange. DPS confirmed [a report from The Texan](https://substack.com/redirect/cf182d62-4299-41b3-a227-6dc208d73167?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the arrested man held far-left political views and was heading to the Capitol with the intent to harm individuals with opposing beliefs. DPS on Monday said no charges have been filed against the man in connection with the alleged threats against state lawmakers. The agency has yet to name the suspect.

Earlier Saturday, DPS had warned state lawmakers and legislative staffers of "credible threats" to legislators planning to attend the Austin "No Kings" protest.

That DPS alert was sent out just before 1 p.m., according to screenshots of emails obtained by The Texas Tribune, and a DPS spokesperson told the Tribune the Capitol was evacuated shortly after. The warning came hours before several Texas federal, state and city elected officials spoke at a protest against President **Donald Trump** in downtown Austin.

In a letter to Gov.**Greg Abbott** and DPS Director Freeman Martin around the start of the protest, Texas House Democratic Leader **Gene Wu** and 43 other members of the Democratic caucus requested updates on what steps DPS is taking to protect lawmakers and other elected officials. The caucus also said the shooting against the Minnesota lawmakers was "the direct result of years of inflammatory rhetoric, threats, and dehumanization that have turned political disagreements into insurgent violence."

"The rhetoric that has poisoned our national political discourse -- calling political opponents 'enemies of the people,' describing immigrants as 'invaders,' and urging followers to 'Fight, fight, fight,' -- has now also claimed the lives of dedicated public servants," they continued. "For years, and just like the shooting in El Paso, violent rhetoric has stoked the flames of division and resulted in tragedy."

Before DPS confirmed the arrest,**Jeffrey Clemmons** , communications director for state Sen. **Sarah Eckhardt** , told the Tribune that DPS arrested someone "who was going to agitate the protest."

Eckhardt was among the officials scheduled to speak at the Capitol protest. Other elected officials who spoke at the event include Democratic U.S. Rep. **Lloyd Doggett** and Democratic state Rep.**John Bucy III**.

Austin City Council Member **Zo Qadri** , who was also at the Capitol protest, expressed gratitude to law enforcement over the arrest.

"Everyone -- lawmakers and attendees alike -- deserves to gather and protest without fear," Qadri said in a written statement to the Tribune. "It's important to condemn the winds of hate that give rise to political violence that has been threatened in Austin today, and tragically witnessed in Minnesota this morning."" “**Texas DPS makes arrest after warning state lawmakers of “credible threats” tied to Capitol protest,** ” Texas Tribune's**Renzo Downey** and**Ayden Runnels** – “The Texas Department of Public Safety says it has arrested one person in connection to the “credible threats” made to state lawmakers planning to attend an anti-Trump rally at the Capitol in Austin, hours after two Democratic Minnesota legislators and their spouses were shot early Saturday morning.

“A short time ago, a Trooper with the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) took one person into custody in connection with the threats made against state lawmakers who planned to attend today’s protest at the Texas State Capitol Complex,” DPS spokesperson **Ericka Miller** said in a statement.

DPS says there is no additional active threat.

The person was arrested after a traffic stop in La Grange. DPS confirmed [a report from The Texan](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.Tb7ejk-5QfVnOrZFvpt2rl16VjvB-dZJ_gDJaXjC-BddUMM5eXRYdnnuSeivt84BIYSdFSuWrmKIeiCEUCb5o5D9MB365R8NL3d-35FowLrYh3999WKpF6H1XRdXI8c2uJ6AQ4ltEyoGXwXf6sUX1cflgOodlFnzzsnTrjnnDUQGBo5HZvOdsEVPtvEsVkFY_6E1ZghxaXboaVILO9ux8U3OUhDLefWmyM8-mF8CDHyOyiVZqfwVNq5UrG_CLvSMI_EYVAMzfLxc_1quR4mnI9aG3fZTrPGW8SYV5asqrud5AxBQEELGMbo1bBxyRGpSjkRDVuTG2WmRbv_-WlFI6GDbihtCHJ1qZ_IC2gABfC_vYJoIBUweOulzhNj2vN3AvV7v_sM5wnWPtoTNeAqnsayLuaUSSu0MIhuWG2XgZjI/4hf/rLqDnUceT62ikZiaeELTPg/h11/h001.U6cVEQ9zP1y_LlwW3-_da9-u2qv8xQ19Is6u1bybps0) that the arrested man held far-left political views and was heading to the Capitol with the intent to harm individuals with opposing beliefs. DPS on Monday said no charges have been filed against the man in connection with the alleged threats against state lawmakers. The agency has yet to name the suspect.

Earlier Saturday, DPS had warned state lawmakers and legislative staffers of “credible threats” to legislators planning to attend the Austin “No Kings” protest.

That DPS alert was sent out just before 1 p.m., according to screenshots of emails obtained by The Texas Tribune, and a DPS spokesperson told the Tribune the Capitol was evacuated shortly after. The warning came hours before several Texas federal, state and city elected officials spoke at a protest against President **Donald Trump** in downtown Austin.

In a letter to Gov.**Greg Abbott** and DPS Director Freeman Martin around the start of the protest, Texas House Democratic Leader **Gene Wu** and 43 other members of the Democratic caucus requested updates on what steps DPS is taking to protect lawmakers and other elected officials. The caucus also said the shooting against the Minnesota lawmakers was “the direct result of years of inflammatory rhetoric, threats, and dehumanization that have turned political disagreements into insurgent violence.”

“The rhetoric that has poisoned our national political discourse — calling political opponents ‘enemies of the people,’ describing immigrants as ‘invaders,’ and urging followers to ‘Fight, fight, fight,’ — has now also claimed the lives of dedicated public servants,” they continued. “For years, and just like the shooting in El Paso, violent rhetoric has stoked the flames of division and resulted in tragedy.”

Before DPS confirmed the arrest,**Jeffrey Clemmons** , communications director for state Sen. **Sarah Eckhardt** , told the Tribune that DPS arrested someone “who was going to agitate the protest.”

Eckhardt was among the officials scheduled to speak at the Capitol protest. Other elected officials who spoke at the event include Democratic U.S. Rep. **Lloyd Doggett** and Democratic state Rep.**John Bucy III**.

Austin City Council Member **Zo Qadri** , who was also at the Capitol protest, expressed gratitude to law enforcement over the arrest.

“Everyone — lawmakers and attendees alike — deserves to gather and protest without fear,” Qadri said in a written statement to the Tribune. “It’s important to condemn the winds of hate that give rise to political violence that has been threatened in Austin today, and tragically witnessed in Minnesota this morning.”" [Texas Tribune](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.xjnMFfva-73dHOne5Rc0eCyDm7YZItPaA-BvJlf4tsCzeqMgMUffj7fewda-YkdU_Z6Rde0VyMdXqjx-tINvjSKpCeMgvnfcJUp1qJCMy3c6e_ujYyuzCidg9pkL_zZPthNUtMT76OC2JQpRZ_fTXA3JrLvBiSR8B6PUEuV9WzKSgAhT1pRoopmYDeS3JmIqO2bX7KwhM9MzO40QntHZzWpVN1iFrvKoWoVdC_pkWwQ3cWC4SyWXnHEQXCThdyvokPuqcwt-799u2btQpYCOaT7z-aLLTGp3Ct83BywEERrZuXYhhauhDMkm0HrRUBot0VliByhOmYydy1ux2UiBTtGuYwcF39j2Dhsb1nSgATVAhOdbGdVdrVM0FscuISGZqFYbIeCrbXbraYtXl4K4djKyQ0-5Tpx-DndKhHZ1aQlVZAkXZNFf_NQ4eosIjaOI3frpU6lCT3trZbiPE9YR5w/4hf/rLqDnUceT62ikZiaeELTPg/h13/h001.3eRmRw2belfCd41HH17pzyx6YWl3QneBJ55acFq0ers)

DPS says there is no additional active threat. » The person was arrested after a traffic stop in La Grange. DPS confirmed that the arrested man held far-left political views and was heading to the Capitol with the intent to harm individuals with opposing beliefs. DPS on Monday said no charges have been filed against the man in connection with the alleged threats against state lawmakers. The agency has yet to name the suspect. Earlier Saturday, DPS had warned state lawmakers and legislative staffers of “credible threats” to legislators planning to attend the Austin “No Kings” protest. » That DPS alert was sent out just before 1 p.m., according to screenshots of emails obtained by The Texas Tribune, and a DPS spokesperson told the Tribune the Capitol was evacuated shortly after. The warning came hours before several Texas federal, state and city elected officials spoke at a protest against President Donald Trump in downtown Austin. In a letter to Gov.Greg Abbott and DPS Director Freeman Martin around the start of the protest, Texas House Democratic Leader Gene Wu and 43 other members of the Democratic caucus requested updates on what steps DPS is taking to protect lawmakers and other elected officials. The caucus also said the shooting against the Minnesota lawmakers was “the direct result of years of inflammatory rhetoric, threats, and dehumanization that have turned political disagreements into insurgent violence.” “The rhetoric that has poisoned our national political discourse — calling political opponents ‘enemies of the people,’ describing immigrants as ‘invaders,’ and urging followers to ‘Fight, fight, fight,’ — has now also claimed the lives of dedicated public servants,” they continued. “For years, and just like the shooting in El Paso, violent rhetoric has stoked the flames of division and resulted in tragedy.” Before DPS confirmed the arrest,Jeffrey Clemmons , communications director for state Sen. Sarah Eckhardt , told the Tribune that DPS arrested someone “who was going to agitate the protest.” Eckhardt was among the officials scheduled to speak at the Capitol protest. Other elected officials who spoke at the event include Democratic U.S. Rep. Lloyd Doggett and Democratic state Rep.John Bucy III. Austin City Council Member Zo Qadri , who was also at the Capitol protest, expressed gratitude to law enforcement over the arrest. “Everyone — lawmakers and attendees alike — deserves to gather and protest without fear,” Qadri said in a written statement to the Tribune. “It’s important to condemn the winds of hate that give rise to political violence that has been threatened in Austin today, and tragically witnessed in Minnesota this morning.”" | FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. #### **Trump Mandate and Congressional Action Target Ranked-Choice Voting**
---
---
|
---
#### WASHINGTON, D.C. – The first major salvo came in March 2025, when the President signed the Executive Order on Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections.
#### This order initiated a necessary increase in the Executive Branch's oversight of federal elections, demanding stricter requirements for voter registration and mail-in ballots. While advocates for the flawed RCV system nervously view the order as a sign of greater federal involvement, patriots see it as a critical first step toward a complete prohibition of RCV, with many believing a specific executive ban is imminent.
#### A Unified Front to Stop a Corrupt System President Trump's executive action is bolstered by a growing movement in Congress to outlaw RCV at the federal level. Lawmakers have introduced powerful legislation, including the One Vote One Choice Act (H.R. 3704) and the Preventing Ranked Choice Corruption Act (H.R. 3040), to explicitly ban this undemocratic voting method in all federal elections. This legislative push is a direct response to RCV's inherent flaws.
#### Election integrity advocates have proven the system:
#### Deliberately Confuses Voters: RCV's complex ranking system is a nightmare for voters, creating chaos at the ballot box and leading to thousands of invalidated "exhausted" ballots where citizens' votes are simply thrown out.
#### Destroys the "One Person, One Vote" Principle: RCV violates the sacred American principle of one clear vote per person by creating a confusing process of vote redistribution that ultimately manufactures winners who were not the first choice of the most voters.
#### Is Fiscally Irresponsible: Alaska’s disastrous experiment with RCV in 2022 cost taxpayers over $11 million—a staggering 328% increase—squandered on opaque software and attempts to explain an inexplicable system.
#### Battleground DC: Congress Fights Back The fight against RCV has now reached the nation's capital. In 2024, voters in the District of Columbia passed Initiative 83, a measure to install RCV in local elections.
#### However, leaders in Congress are refusing to allow this flawed system to take root in Washington. While the initial window for a simple disapproval of the law has passed, RCV opponents have signaled their clear intent to nullify the measure using the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act (H.R. 4563).
#### This crucial legislation will be used to explicitly ban RCV in the District, making the capital a model for election integrity, not a showcase for a corrupt voting experiment. Alaska: A National Warning of RCV's Failure The urgency of these actions is underscored by the catastrophe of RCV in Alaska.
#### The system, imposed on the state by narrow margins, has been a disaster, producing distorted results that many argue are not reflective of the voters' true will.
#### The widespread opposition was made clear when a 2024 citizen-led initiative to repeal RCV came within a handful of votes of succeeding after 2-3 weeks of counting, proving the public's rejection of this failed experiment.
#### From the White House to the halls of Congress to the 17 States that have already banned RCV, leaders are taking decisive action. The message is clear: the movement to restore the 'one person, one vote' principle is strong, and the effort to ban the undemocratic RCV system from American elections has never been more critical.

#### **In 2001, Enron collapsed under the weight of one of the largest corporate frauds in American history—over $25 billion evaporated overnight, leaving pensions gutted and lives destroyed. It was called the smartest disaster money could buy.**
#### But what if the next Enron wasn’t a corporation?
What if it was your own government?
#### This film asks the billion-dollar question:
**What happens when a state quietly reallocates tens of billions of dollars meant for its citizens—without a vote, without consent, and without accountability?**
#### We follow the money—through shadowy nonprofits, bloated bureaucracies, and politically connected networks like **Arabella Advisors** , **Alaska Venture Fund** , and the **1630 Fund**.
#### It’s a financial betrayal not buried in spreadsheets—but broadcast in silence.
**$25 billion gone** —not from shareholders this time, but from the people of Alaska.

### **Now we have 108 supporters for “Frozen Odds”**
---
#### **Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process.**
#### **Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

name: Warner Mendenhall, Freedom Counsel
subject: Were you forced to take the shot?
body:
Millions of people walked away from their jobs because they were being forced to take the deadly COVID shot.

|
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z50oul3jsmv35rmnrp6o8bm87v0i8kdsca08din8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chim2ob6cjh2bs)
Friend,

**Millions of people** walked away from their jobs because they were being forced to take the **deadly** COVID shot.

Americans sensed their rights were being violated by their employers and by the government, so they stood up for their constitutional rights and walked away from their jobs and livelihoods.

**Now, we’re holding these corrupt employers and the government accountable! **

Two attorneys in LA, Jonathan Cherne and Alan Reinach, recently represented an LA Physician Assistant who was fired for being unvaccinated.

**They won their client $912,000 for her unconstitutional firing. She was also awarded $15,000 per month until reinstated. With interest, it will be more than $950,000.**

Both attorneys are involved with Freedom Counsel.

This case reminds me of why I started this organization in the first place. I'm Warner Mendenhall, co-founder of Freedom Counsel, and I'd like to share with you the important work we're doing at Freedom Counsel to help those affected by COVID policies.

Freedom Counsel is trying to make sure we are developing pathways for citizens to be empowered to defend their rights and to fight and reclaim this country for what it really is.

**Freedom Counsel emerged from the COVID Litigation Conference in Atlanta in 2023 with a clear purpose:** to provide legal support and coordination for those seeking justice and accountability through the court system. We work alongside dedicated attorneys, medical professionals, scientists, and concerned citizens to address the challenges many Americans continue to face.

But we can’t fight this alone.

[Can we count on you to help Freedom Counsel fight the tremendous damage to the constitutional rights of Americans? Donate now >>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6k4rse9qhuoch69rjp0vtrenmk9m9f6j6g5spl0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chim2ob6cjh2bs)

One of the things I find most compelling is that American citizens have really stood up for their own constitutional rights.

We’ve had a real awakening to –
* Constitutional rights
* Privacy
* Religious freedom
* Medical freedom
* Right to speak

All of these rights have been revived in the population because they came under attack by our own government. The government came at us through every institution in our daily lives.

This is the new civil rights movement.

Our rights have been taken away in every area of our lives, but American citizens are reclaiming the Constitution and our individual rights by holding these bad actors accountable. [Your immediate support will help Freedom Counsel empower Americans to restore and reclaim their constitutional rights. Click below to donate >>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zpikd6pub5jlv9n0rc31oiq3qa2sjujjrl4aq2c0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chim2ob6cjh2bs)

Americans know what happened during COVID was wrong.

That’s why so many millions of people are still fighting for accountability from the government.

**We need to make sure that everyone understands we are a movement, and we are going to keep going after employers who violated religious rights, the right to bodily autonomy, and medical exemptions. **

[Please donate any amount below to ensure those who violated our rights are held accountable!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvqlhhs0bsd0hjfm7q55eijl5f9h0l0l4brurri0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chim2ob6cjh2bs)

If you've been affected by these policies or know someone who has, please know that you're not alone. We're here to help coordinate legal resources and support.

## Israel Bombs Iran TV During Broadcast
President Trump on Monday urged [“immediate evacuation” of Tehran](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-SqyAUxp8GOzKIIElBcRu73HZL5yhHPbsgDpwkk7ffMa-w9fdvvt_XfbwDRdrX_5DQ85LHHV81IjOWkWoBjARUKhf6wXrgzrDmfdRKW6l62boxAMX3aJrgF0SNXYO-dVa11jjTNZsH1fVGh0lhi7cwaTeZ6-JgCsGhcddbQ_5sU33rWqWsaS822Nnc3GSVmeZu0cIoDMS5XL4z7bzhEt_5ieUy59REvzEfVXT_hB6EHnjDjWI8NaGHLSc8Dwk9QEi0U-UCTHkXerCd7ZxRkssjHfJRVqySUsJAwCjxCfPjY5V5kYxbgTPUFB-OF8VItXfCqDUBfcYa_hO9p9e_AQAA___4loWk) after Iran rejected a U.S.-proposed nuclear deal. Earlier that day, Israeli airstrikes hit Iranian state media facilities in Tehran during a live broadcast, sending debris falling into the studio as anchors fled from the set. [See a video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQRp8Gd6wAg1kXFBslTnWTIkWUyuJnvJ4EgwVcW_v2kZNHuNUURxp95_x8m98sRkzPb3YD05Y8JzhrhNagzFiLhYgWS20F_0DdITX7zGkWTCjKBsr1HCzG1yy7YBYAAX0HhmvFuJJa9t1qxsXduV_03SsXxBiCcAoG6fWd9-PoQofm-sYGrjljSvKbCsrLUTvFpPP9IohkELDlcvudMbUVlvjKB5Sbz1sXzdraXkn_IGIiYjrP87bVdDEiJkj0vRIxXVIXzCWG69rmV_pfj7q8uUqx2IQ20dpsA9oOGt4LpieNeAB1JdvgbW1ETLbQx4N__f5r-EL6KXsMpP_86SoIZ_0BZe-KCfuJMWIdNJHsuVmM_7a2DwU-jPgbAAD__8AYkVc). Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended the attacks and [refused to rule out targeting Iran’s Supreme Leader](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAUhZ8Gd4z4NTMFRaTI3UbpUlrX5jK-WQwWMDvy20fOK2x1iiMdne_78zF_ACXKz1-wo--xzBnfLWHvWGdqFTARUG290ie2A3OHZ8mzEspyMXLp5gCUztkMwUdEhXpAL50V0hpn9LD5e5CLG0PUdpRLAGGNjVFHq4J7QHyYgfy1JkbppBDWyJsNdjUPt1hhllVHxYzAQL3U299CuW8Y01m-sN7Wsg_Jb70fjekfTE1MTbCsF8HtWa6aqel3SdRpbUxNGTvkE7YX75hS47CsvL4uet7h8wqqkBtvr6PijjwhBKxMTa2XejI9UWD6p1TqPt6ttEP14XhTStRGx4x47kDp_6n-LZNfXv0LAAD___vIiNQ), saying such action could “end the conflict.” Tehran has reported at least 224 deaths since Friday; Israel says 24 of its citizens have been killed. The strikes follow four days of escalating missile exchanges. ## 'Trump Mobile' Enters Smartphone Market
The Trump Organization is entering the wireless market with “rump Mobile, a new 5G phone service and smartphone brand announced Monday. [See the phone here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdEb2ssa5wkUaukubEhlYjk2MjWzn0P19RH4h3Ugjzei9z_t49xw4Pj78Tq6uaYx0lkC1Uh65ZE-BPedSM39TOShW_0hxBAVGql5qOy6ew2vEZnErEVDXkNPWKG3QYtdsDrHrYVqRVj-t9GZVN82gaDE3QG3h1rC71lSvrVbKoG7NYma82ckonOZuBYGKFq4pt1-JY91oDa_0pNzOaW-C22o9iujeBQwChvM823kqF8XVCxiuKGCo-Wc_5J4mDiSPLUWSVUu0Eo3cU6ybgKHJbjlODoFLbwWqx-45_N3Uf7l5OvgNAAD__1W6eBs). The plan, dubbed “The 47 Plan,” costs $47.45 per month—referencing [Donald Trump’s presidential terms](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u5CAUhZ8Gd1j8DnZBsauVu9k2pQXm2r4JBguYGU2ePprkEVIeHenofN_bdb46jJi2_-4A29Y8J3jUCK1BmbEWBxEdltoKfkA9ITW35TQLJjRlF8rNHBzG56y6YFcAAbIDy41mXCujZLdbxTUMi2RyNd75YZCwaOlHPw6cBx9Yh_a1xi7ccMa04r0OelGj8Zopv8hVEMUgYMulf8-Y2g5rfOY7lH7JRxft3tpZifxDxETE5PzyIui3_KqJmP7eKiaolYipldtx0iN7jEB_Qi6bS_jpGuZUaYIHPfecgJ7RJSKm2nJ5EjlhIPIfF2IYhRlNV2w4Hxgj1oshim2Hw_j9pv1K4d2KrwAAAP__Q8iGdA)—and includes unlimited talk, text, and data, plus perks like roadside assistance and telehealth. The Trump Mobile service is a white-label plan built on an existing mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) called Liberty Mobile. The gold-colored T1 Phone, retailing at $499, will launch in September. Pre-orders are [available here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykjz1u9CAUAE8D3Vr8PIxcUHyNu_3alAjMs_0SbCwgu9rbR5srpB7NSPNx9_dAmc7tfzjQ9bX4E58tY-9YPbUaMFOg2nqlL2wXnj1s5fRKKHMT401anwLllwee3IqoUHN00hohDVjQfHc2YQIJ0wJTUlHoMI0q6mRDlBBQICf3rolRWimEATmYZBaYbDQC4qJXxUBgol7q8Fno7Duu-VUeWIelHDy7vferMf2PqZmpudfv4zpKpIxvztTMq0vXk3KmNloGYjsC5V-3_2n44dRPAAAA___vfmoq). Led by Eric and Donald Trump Jr., the venture plans to build the phones in the U.S. and aims to appeal to consumers seeking “America First” alternatives in tech.
## Career Spy Named MI6’s First Woman Chief
Blaise Metreweli, 47, a veteran intelligence officer, will become the [first woman to lead MI6](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu8yAUBeCnwVssuIAhA8O_eMu_drQwXCe3JSYCFJI-feW-QrcjHemTzvm4LBdPifbrf39H17a87NhrwtawLFSLx0SeSm2FvrA-cG_-mvcFOOgTn07CLNFTei9qiG5DBJQDOmE0F1oZJYebi8auVuowIUgbuDnbqG3Q9gxSWfDbQO7Q-CSM4FwrMeqogzqbVXO1BrkBUxwjtVzGz0x7u-GW3vmJZQz5PiR3a-1RmfzHYGYw997HdQ1Hx2A-xjCYfWkUEh4xfL_eL67iU_Q8FBcfnVKiOhmm-PXuKf2q7U9XPB38BAAA__9OaXJW), the U.K.’s foreign spy agency, in its 116-year history. Currently serving [as Director General “Q”](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupSAYhJ8GOwwgyLGg2MbubLulAfzRfxfBAHuMb3_jfYXbziST-b4_7-VtMWLaftsDTAt5SXDVCK1BWbAWCxEtltoK_oN6Qmp2y2kRTCjKRsr1slqM9yK71QQAAUMHhmvFuJJaDt1uponrIIOywNnAJnCOv7zzTo1TUC_rOzTPGhu55owpyXu1Ki8n7RSTzg9BEMlgxZZL_zdjajuEeOcPlN7no4tmb-2sZPhFxEzEfF1Xn5x_KJ7-SXKJKxEz_C_5BCJmV7BZTJUeONJ63tRukPxNN2iVhgeWBjhsBOp3hECLT1bwgU-6K2Y9L4wR66iJZNthMX7faD9y9zHiKwAA___3NoTE)—the head of MI6’s technology and innovation division tasked with protecting agent identities—Metreweli will take the reins this fall, replacing Sir Richard Moore as the agency’s 18th “C,” Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced. Metreweli joined MI6 in 1999 and rose through the ranks with deep experience in the Middle East, Europe, and tech innovation. Until now, only James Bond films had cast [a woman as MI6 chief](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuOrDAURFcDmZH_pgMHLyHrl06IbHxp7rSNkW01YvcjZguTVkmlU-frOT8dRtxf_10C29Y873DWCK1BmbEWBxEdltoKvqEesDf3yvvMKVeEasLMHBzGa5Z9sCsAB9GDZUZRpqSRot-s949F64dnUnMZhA9acTOaBWhQYRxFj_Zeo5oZRqmSbFBBLfJhvKLSL2LlnaQQsOUyfGfc2wZrvPIHyrDk1Ee7tXbUTvzr-NTx6cYf6vu6y45PteVydXxaXAEopB4X8dFhBZKgFTghImmZeFhyArLeT8mZk9vvdAMXSEJNmBCj5Eb1xYbjxBixatNJ-koO4y9G-5O7j-U_AQAA__9Rw4PZ)—Dame Judi Dench’s “M” held the fictional post from 1995 to 2015.

# Vitriol Without a Cause: NoKing Protest Lacked Message, Overflowed with Hate

---
| Over the weekend, a brave brigade of octogenarian keyboard warriors took to the streets—armed with walkers, warbly speeches, and laminated signs—valiantly resisting the tyranny of **mean tweets.** Yes, the same folks who champion mandates for masks, mandates for cars, mandates for your kid’s classroom and your town’s zoning... are now warning us about kings.
**You can’t make this up. But don’t mistake their outrage for courage** —it’s **not protest, it’s projection.**
Be proud of where we’re headed. And frankly? I’ll take a mean tweet over this circus any day.

## Abbott Signs Property Tax Cut Measures
Gov. Greg Abbott [signed a package of property tax relief bills](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu3DAQBNCvoToedimJsgoW1yhI4SBd0gmUubIYU6RArk3p74O7X3A5GOBhMH9e51frg4_vv-xOhs81zZFqCcRMeV4tb5SLs9eRbfxAAIAt2cXPClQvQUscZmd9uOaucWYBN2JDBocesH8BrZvN6HFwLS1LO4JSI1JPenxprR4IO90RNt48MNA4IAJCe1MtdoBIvRrWtnNvogNynlO-8UZMpy1ruNIX5dtb2ptgNuajiPYu1CTUVGu97SU-OqEmivKzCDXtKdIl1MT2pEeum2X5tOSWdko1Ui4yEjnJSX7EVKVd0ifLI6eDMl-S7SkzBU-rUJPN8n7HH7___vzXZOOO6kPwRQ-ig_fd-vBcxt_788uo_wEAAP__qBuIoA) yesterday in Denton. He was joined by State Rep. Morgan Meyer (R-Dallas) and State Sen. Paul Bettencourt (R-Houston), key lawmakers who advocated for the legislation’s passage. Senate Bill 4 [increases the homestead exemption](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQhZ8GM6YaRL0GBJuQ3U03tFpolRpGLOgdx7ffcl_hJic6dX6-P9_TN8YU9_U3vsjyZ8nTTmdNxExlWpA3KjXgdRTcnwoAYMs4x0mD7iT0Ug1TwJiuyTTBzhBG1ZBVQweq-4K-bzaLLbZLACJjfD9qCmYchvkLFhjN6DvTRHuHQa8GpUBB-9CtMqAUdXpYWhO8MEAhci4P3ojpg3VJV35Tefj8apLdmI8q2l9CO6HdeZ4Pn6J_6i3_rZz32yW0u28J7VL2mIR2d6fQDnqhnbplzW-J85yZJWdZ47rLQj6XIOdC-Iz7Ko-SDyp8ScaPLJQiLXKOKVUZd84y4Sm0a4oNxxlTirUfhIH1hTH9X8o_4_u2-l8AAAD__-kqjUg) for school property taxes from $100,000 to $140,000 for all homeowners, providing a projected average annual savings of $484. House Bill 9 increases the exemption for business personal property from $2,500 to $125,000. We couldn’t bring you the news without the support of our community—and that includes the incredible sponsors backing this year’s [Mountain Majesty Gala](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Lots of news today... We encourage you to check out the website so you don't miss a thing. Also, listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Lawmakers are also rushing to fix a [rape kit backlog](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that’s left survivors waiting years for justice. In Denver, small businesses are under pressure as the city [cracks down on signage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), fining shops for long-standing flags and banners. Meanwhile, the “No Kings” protest turned violent, with [35 arrested](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after clashing with police downtown.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** National tensions spiked as Trump [deployed ICE to sanctuary cities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) following the violent “No Kings” protests, and in L.A., [Marines assisting DHS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) stirred debate after detaining a civilian on U.S. soil.. In Minnesota, a [suspect was arrested](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after assassinating former House Speaker Melissa Hortman.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Dr. Krannawitter argues that the Declaration of Independence—not modern slogans—is the [true “No Kings” manifesto](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), grounded in natural rights and self-government. Heidi Ganahl makes the [case for Home Rule](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Douglas County to push back against growing state control. And John DiGirolamo delivers a [chilling exposé on online predators](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), recounting how an officer posing as a 13-year-old was immediately targeted—underscoring the urgent need for parental vigilance in today’s digital world.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, June 17, 2025.
– Team RMV
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Ganahl: Local voices, local values, local control–Home Rule for Douglas County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_By now, you’ve probably received your ballot—and with it, an opportunity that could redefine how we govern ourselves. This vote will decide who sits on the commission responsible for drafting our Home Rule Charter. That document will set the tone for the future of Douglas County, and I believe it’s time we step up and take control of that future ourselves._
_If we choose Home Rule, we gain the power to tailor our government to meet our needs—not someone else’s idea of what those needs should be._
_Let’s call it like it is—too often, the laws coming out of Denver are written without Douglas County in mind. We’re not just growing—we’re growing with purpose. And let’s be real, Douglas County has its own way of doing things. Home Rule lets us manage that growth on our terms, protect the land we love, and build smart—not just follow the blueprint of state government overregulation._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[Justice on hold: Lawmakers race to fix Colorado’s rape kit backlog](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado faces a backlog of nearly 1,400 untested rape kits, delaying justice and potentially enabling repeat offenders.
* Two bipartisan bills—HB25-1275 and SB25-304—aim to fix systemic failures exposed by the Missy Woods scandal, including delayed victim notifications and lack of lab accountability.
* Clearing the backlog could prevent over 1,400 crimes and save the state an estimated $234.7 million, with lawmakers pushing for reforms to restore trust in the system.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[DiGirolamo: Undercover as a 13-year-old, an officer finds what parents fear most](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* An officer posing as a 13-year-old girl was contacted by multiple predators within minutes of creating a fake social media profile, many requesting explicit photos or meetups.
* One man arrested in the sting had targeted over 100 minors—and was set to marry a woman with a 13-year-old daughter the very next day.
* The operation reveals just how easily predators exploit social media, underscoring the urgent need for parental oversight and digital vigilance.

Hi, Peter, I'm Christina Bohannan.

I’m a mom, engineer, law professor, and former Iowa state representative, and I'm running for Congress in the most competitive race in the country to unseat Mariannette Miller-Meeks.

If we already know each other and you're fired up to help me flip Iowa’s 1st congressional district blue, [**I would love for you to become a Founding Donor of our campaign by making a donation today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109726807/552055275/-1606373703?refcode=em25_250617_lau1_fndd_gq_act_90d_CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250617_lau1_fndd_gq_act_90d_CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=49bd5e91-744b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWJkNWU5MS03NDRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b2sJy2p0kf3fpO32NM2yz6wGqzs_-KC7sV289A-8ohw=)

If we haven’t met yet, I want to tell you a little about who I am and why I'm running:

I grew up in a trailer in a town of 700, and neither of my parents graduated from high school. Every day, my parents got up and went to work, doing everything they could to put food on the table for our family. But when my dad got sick, and his health insurance was canceled, my family lost everything, and we had to choose between that food and the care my dad desperately needed.

It’s thanks to hard work, teachers, and public education that I got a fair shot, becoming the first in my family to graduate from college. And it’s public education that drew me to the great state of Iowa, where I moved so I could give my daughter a chance at a quality public education that I knew she, too, would need to succeed.

For so many Iowans, that promise of a better life is fading, and the priorities and values we hold dear are being cast aside in favor of political agendas.

**I'm running for Congress because good people all over Iowa have lost faith in our government. Mariannette Miller-Meeks has been nothing but a rubber stamp for her party bosses and is still doing _nothing_ to help the people in our district.**

Miller-Meeks is a threat to our state. Her actions are a direct attack on the members of our community, including farmers, working families, seniors, and educators. Mariannette Miller-Meeks is supporting _every bad policy Washington insiders are spouting._

From voting to cut Medicaid to supporting tariffs that will devastate our farmers to cosponsoring a horrific anti-abortion bill, Miller-Meeks is showing her loyalty is with her political agenda above anything else. But are we really surprised?

This isn't my first time running this race, Peter. **Mariannette Miller-Meeks has been failing our district for a while. That’s why, in 2024, we lost the race by just 799 votes! I'm ready to close the gap with a winning campaign in 2026.**

IA-01 needs a leader who will put the people first, and I know I can be that leader, but a win in 2026 won't be possible without your support.

# Report Cards Are In
---
| |

| As Team TFVC reflects on the 89th Legislative Session, we are deeply grateful for and impressed by the effort that each of you - our **dedicated vaccine choice warriors** \- put toward the cause of advancing medical liberty in the Lone Star State. Not only are we able to celebrate the **passage of _six bills_** , we are delighted to continue our streak of **killing every bad bill** filed, and this is all thanks to you! We had historic amounts of grassroots engagement in 2025, including over 600 online public comments submitted after we sent out our Action Alert in support of HB 3219, Representative Shofner’s bill to make Ivermectin available without a prescription! For more 89th Legislative Session by-the-numbers, see below. As always, we want to arm you with the information needed to make wise decisions at the ballot box by evaluating each lawmaker’s votes on important medical liberty legislation and giving them a **“Report Card”** grade. These grades reflect the Senators’ and Representatives’ dedication to protecting and advancing informed consent, medical privacy, and vaccine choice. There were definitely some **lawmakers who went above and beyond in the battle for medical liberty, and some who fought against us every step of the way.** In the next few weeks, we will announce some new and well-deserved awards for the legislators who boldly led the charge in the 89th Legislative Session, so stay tuned!

This session, we’re proud to have played a role in the passage of an unprecedented six protective medical liberty bills, but there were also quite a few missed opportunities.

# [Don’t let Trump Blunder us into War](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb8e390af-44b3-4f78-a3e0-6402bc2d3182/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T654b1543-b317-403b-ba38-b8fdc0b60c20/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Sometimes you get into war to defend from an attack, or to prevent one. And sometimes you blunder your way into it because your president is a moron, [who posts this](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfe07356a-6004-42f2-83fa-14f99a839add/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) on Truth Social: _**" Everyone should immediately evacuate Tehran!"**_ This is the kind of thing that you say when you are about to carpet bomb someplace. And this is the kind of thing that causes panic, and can lead to preemptive strikes against your country that get a lot of people killed. And if Trump had ever read a history book, or had an advisor who was the least bit competent, he would have known that. Trump says and does [incredibly stupid things](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td1def4e2-aef9-449f-92d0-44a6cb296344/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) on a regular basis, without any internal editing mechanism. Which is bad domestically, but potentially catastrophic when he's injecting his stupidity into an active war zone. Congress has the Constitutional power to rein in Trump from blundering us into an unnecessary war, and it must use that power to avoid disaster. [**Add your name: Don't let Trump Blunder us into War**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta9f9d1ca-b2a3-4533-9a1a-ec1817397f36/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

\-- Republicans are not showing up...

Hi Peter,

As abortion bans swept the nation after the fall of _Roe v. Wade_ , there is only one remaining safe haven state for abortion access in the South: **Virginia.**

The Trump administration has already announced federal policies that put women’s lives and well-being in danger, so we will be looking to state governments to defend us. This year, all eyes are on Virginia’s elections as the state currently has an extremely slim 1-vote margin in favor of abortion access in its legislature. We’re writing today because **Virginia’s primary elections are happening _TODAY._**

[**We need to move quickly: Help our qualified endorsed candidates reach as many voters as possible TODAY by rushing a split contribution of $20.25 or more today →**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hbm-va/?refcode=M_F_250617VAprimaryD_N_CD_NO_10_NG_N_L1&amount=20.25) **Here is a look at our endorsed candidates who will be in the most consequential races TODAY:

✅ Lt. Gov. candidate Ghazala Hashmi** – Senator Hashmi helped draft Virginia’s constitutional amendment protecting safe and legal abortion, and served as a Chief Co-Patron for the legislation. **She is the _only woman_ in a seven-candidate primary, and is the most experienced legislator in the race.**

**✅ May Nivar** – Running for a seat that has been named the TOP pickup opportunity for securing a pro-choice majority in Virginia. Her opponent, the Republican incumbent, passed zero bills during his 2025 legislative session, and an independent analysis by the Virginia Public Access Project found him to be the least effective legislator in Virginia.

He has said he would like to see abortion become illegal in Virginia and has repeatedly voted against commonsense gun safety policies, paid medical leave, lower prescription drug costs, and more...

**✅ Shannon Jones** – Running for Commonwealth Attorney – Newport News, VA. It has been 35 years – more than 3 DECADES – since Shannon’s incumbent opponent has even had to campaign/appeal to voters. No one has run against him in 35 years! Shannon is highly qualified to take on his position, **and is the first woman to be listed as a candidate on the ballot for the job.**

With reproductive healthcare access under dire threat, a Republican frontrunner for Governor who wants to ELIMINATE abortion access in the state, and a 1-vote margin in the State Legislature, **_the stakes could not be higher._**

[**These candidates are facing competitive primaries TODAY and, in many cases, are falling behind their male opponents in fundraising. Help ensure these candidates have the funds they’ll need to reach voters in these final hours by rushing a split donation immediately.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109738775/552084388/892077722?refcode=M_F_250617VAprimaryD_N_CD_NO_10_NG_N_L2&amount=20.25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEzMTBjZTMyLTdmNGItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=RtwxWNGkFuFYFHcEReiOur7z2qxcj_lykflSvWdY9L4=)

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: How this travel myth could upset your next trip
body:
Hi Peter,

It's time to dispel the myth that travel safety is the same for everyone.
It's not.
This isn't a one-size-fits-all issue, and there's no cookie-cutter solution that works 100% of the time for everyone.
Why not?
Because some of us have to take some extra precautions when we travel.
First-time travelers, for instance, may need to be _extra_ careful not to stick out like a sore thumb. If they do, they could be a magnet for scammers.
Women, LGBTQ folks, and people who need accommodation adapted for a disability can all face distinct risks too.1
And those can be pretty significant, depending on where they're going and what they plan to do.1
But regardless of whether you're a more vulnerable traveler or you may be vacationing with one, those risks don't have to overshadow the rewards of getting away.
If you know some basic travel safety, you can tailor it to your needs and your trip.
And you can be proactive about protecting yourself and setting yourself up for a fabulous vacation.

| | | _**- A Personal Note from Congresswoman Young Kim - **_
Dear, Friend,

You may not know me, but this is Congresswoman Young Kim, and I would really appreciate it if you would take a moment to read my story.

I am a Christian, mother, wife, small business owner, and a first-generation immigrant.

When I moved to America, I didn't speak a word of English. But I worked hard, put myself through school, and am now one of the first Korean-American women to serve in Congress. But my road hasn't been exactly easy.

_In 2018, I ran for Congress and I lost my election._

But I wouldn't let myself give up no matter how hard the Democrats tried to make me. So I ran again in 2020, and despite MILLIONS in spending against me, we won. **Together, we flipped a DEEP BLUE seat RED for the FIRST TIME in 26 years. **

Every year since then, we've continued to defy the odds to stop the woke Democrat machine and keep this seat for House Republicans.

_I 'm nothing special._ Just an immigrant who came to this country - not knowing a word of English - who lived the American Dream. And I've made it my mission on Capitol Hill to help make that same Dream possible for everyone.

But now, the Democrats are once again after my seat. They are angry that I flipped a deep Blue seat Red, and they want it back. _The far-Left knows that my seat could very well decide the House Majority and they are DESPERATE for revenge._

GOP Rep. Steve Scalise **[fired back at Democrat Rep. Hakeem Jeffries](https://substack.com/redirect/76f2d281-adfc-4f29-a06c-331d5dd79107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for complaining that Republicans were "cruelly" targeting Sesame Street in their effort to cut waste, fraud and abuse from the federal government.
"Sesame Street is not going away, it will be just fine, what will go away is some of the far-left radical views that are being espoused!!" Scalise sounded off.
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/76f2d281-adfc-4f29-a06c-331d5dd79107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/76f2d281-adfc-4f29-a06c-331d5dd79107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"By the way, when this goes away at NPR, you can still turn on about 6 other channels and get the same far-left radical views and they're all going to be private companies!" Scalise added before rifling off several other objectively absurd and ideologically left-wing spending items targeted for cuts by DOGE.
**["$6 million for net zero cities in Mexico?!](https://substack.com/redirect/76f2d281-adfc-4f29-a06c-331d5dd79107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** I know some of their best supporters are waiving a Mexican flag in an American city right now!!" Scalise jabbed, evoking the destructive Los Angeles riots from last week.
"$5.1 million to strengthen the resilience of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, queer global movement? I'm not sure what that movement is but they can continue that movement some other way, not with taxpayer dollars!"

# Iran did not like statement from G7 leaders
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/58c35171-851f-45e1-ae6b-a7d0944fb021?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Iran's Foreign Ministry **[accused the G7 of ignoring Israel's "blatant aggression"](https://substack.com/redirect/58c35171-851f-45e1-ae6b-a7d0944fb021?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** against Iranian territory. Spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei criticized the G7 leaders for disregarding Israel's "unlawful attacks" on Iran's peaceful nuclear infrastructure and the targeting of residential areas that killed Iranian citizens.
* **Iran demanded G7 members take responsibility for what it called an "egregious act of aggression"** \- Baqaei specifically called on the three permanent UN Security Council members within the G7 to shoulder their "legal and moral responsibility" and abandon what he termed "one-sided rhetoric" in favor of addressing Israel's actions.
* **The G7 statement had affirmed Israel's right to self-defense while calling Iran the "principal source of regional instability"** \- The G7 leaders reiterated support for Israel's security, emphasized that Iran can never have nuclear weapons, and urged that resolving the Iranian crisis lead to broader Middle East de-escalation including a Gaza ceasefire.

* * *
# What happened last night: Trump orders immediate evacuation of Tehran
President Donald Trump posted a grave warning last night on Truth Social, abruptly calling for a full evacuation of Iran's capital city, Tehran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9a62c934-f1b5-44d0-a24f-31aad7d523b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump warned "everyone" in Tehran to "immediately evacuate" and left the G7 summit early due to the Iran crisis** \- The president posted the urgent warning on Truth Social Monday night, expressing regret that Iran didn't accept his previous nuclear deal and reiterating that "Iran can not have a nuclear weapon," while cutting his Canada summit attendance short.
* **Trump requested the National Security Council be ready upon his return to Washington** \- About an hour after his evacuation post, the White House confirmed he was departing early "because of what's going on in the Middle East," with reports indicating he asked for the NSC to be prepared in the Situation Room and Secretary of State Marco Rubio returning with him.
* **The evacuation warning affects 330,000 people in central Tehran amid ongoing Israeli strikes** \- The targeted area includes Iran's state TV headquarters, police headquarters, and key hospitals, but Tehran lacks public bomb shelters, forcing most of the city's 9.5 million residents to shelter in basements and subway stations while thousands flee on clogged roadways.

* * *
# _What 's going on?_ Republicans meeting with left-wing org in Italy
Over four dozen Republican congressmen and their spouses **[have reportedly attended luxury conferences at Lake Como,](https://substack.com/redirect/557e47cc-f6e1-4106-b489-d8c3e1b2f13c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Italy, paid for by the left-wing Aspen Institute.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/557e47cc-f6e1-4106-b489-d8c3e1b2f13c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The trips cost $10,000-$15,000 per attendee** and guest, covering business class airfare, meals, and lodging at the Rockefeller Foundation's villa overlooking the lake, including recreational activities like boat rides and gelato tastings.

* **The Aspen Institute claims these are "nonpartisan" educational conferences on policy issues like food security and AI** \- However, the organization has hosted events with controversial figures like Ibram X. Kendi discussing "How to Be an Antiracist" and receives significant funding from the Rockefeller Foundation to promote climate change and clean energy initiatives.
* **Ethics Committee Chairman Michael Guest approved other members' trips while also attending himself** \- The guest signed off on paperwork for other representatives to attend the Lake Como conferences, then disclosed attending two trips himself with his wife, raising potential conflict of interest concerns about the approval process.
* **The location choice is unusual since congressional trips typically visit cities of geopolitical importance** \- Unlike normal foreign travel to places like London, Berlin, or Jerusalem, Lake Como appears chosen primarily for its luxury amenities, with justifications ranging from "appropriate security and meeting space" to "access to experts," according to varying ethics disclosures.

subject: I lost…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Young Kim for Congress
body:
You may not know me.

| |
---
| | | _**- A Personal Note from Congresswoman Young Kim - **_
Dear, Friend,

You may not know me, but this is Congresswoman Young Kim, and I would really appreciate it if you would take a moment to read my story.

I am a Christian, mother, wife, small business owner, and a first-generation immigrant.

When I moved to America, I didn't speak a word of English. But I worked hard, put myself through school, and am now one of the first Korean-American women to serve in Congress. But my road hasn't been exactly easy.

_In 2018, I ran for Congress and I lost my election._

But I wouldn't let myself give up no matter how hard the Democrats tried to make me. So I ran again in 2020, and despite MILLIONS in spending against me, we won. **Together, we flipped a DEEP BLUE seat RED for the FIRST TIME in 26 years. **

Every year since then, we've continued to defy the odds to stop the woke Democrat machine and keep this seat for House Republicans.

_I 'm nothing special._ Just an immigrant who came to this country - not knowing a word of English - who lived the American Dream. And I've made it my mission on Capitol Hill to help make that same Dream possible for everyone.

But now, the Democrats are once again after my seat. They are angry that I flipped a deep Blue seat Red, and they want it back. _The far-Left knows that my seat could very well decide the House Majority and they are DESPERATE for revenge._
---
| | | [SUPPORT YOUNG KIM TODAY](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z53bun44u5fkd8sno12ocrrahqddiif92u8u83h0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chgeao36cth2bs "SUPPORT YOUNG KIM TODAY")

---
This past election cycle they pulled out ALL the stops: recruiting progressive Liberals to run against me, pledging MILLIONS of dollars in attack ads and smear campaigns, and the Biden White House even named me one of their TOP 18 targets. Yet, even with everything they threw at me, I was able to emerge VICTORIOUS thanks to the support of my grassroots supporters like you, Friend.

But that's NOTHING compared to what they are already plotting for this cycle.

**[A Democrat PAC has announced MY SEAT as one of their top targets in 2026.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zld3478pjddkn5u0svbncdhegchqbt28v0372iuo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chgeao36cth2bs "A Democrat PAC has already announced MY SEAT as one of their top targets in 2026.")**

The Democrats are FIRED UP with even more momentum coming off the 2024 election where they were able to FLIP multiple critical GOP California seats BLUE!

_Please don 't let this be my fate next election._

I don't normally ask for help like this, but my campaign is fueled by grassroots supporters just like you, and I urgently need your help to fuel my fight, Friend.

**[I'm coming to you personally today to ask if you could chip in just a few bucks to help make sure my campaign has the necessary resources and momentum to defend my seat and our GOP majority!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zba92qtq2o0gnrgbmvl1gpid5temr63b2ot6o57o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chgeao36cth2bs "I’m coming to you personally today to ask if you could chip in just a few bucks to help make sure my campaign has the necessary resources and momentum to defend my seat and our GOP majority!")**

You’ve _got_ to be kidding me.

**First,** I hear**George Soros** is flooding Texas with millions to try and flip our state blue.

**Now,** **Bernie Sanders** is rolling into town with his “Fighting Oligarchy Tour”... and he’s bringing **Robert Francis,_“Beto,”_ O’Rourke** with him?

_Seriously?
_
“Beto” has lost _everything_ he’s ever run for—Senate, President, Governor—you name it. But the Democrats are so desperate to take over Texas, they’re dusting him off for another round.

I’m not letting that happen. Not on my watch.

**Beth Van Duyne is running for Congress because she knows the people of the 24th District deserve to have a strong, principled voice in Congress.**

Socialism is on the rise, our border crisis has never been worse, and we face constant threats from hostile nations willing to use cyber-attacks, nuclear weapons, and terrorist jihad. When Beth thinks about her two children, she wants them to have the same opportunities in life that she did; She wants them to be able to grow up safe and proud of our country.

**Beth is a single mom, a conservative Republican, a reformer who has defeated government corruption, a believer in the rule of law** who has helped remove thousands of criminal aliens from North Texas, a leader who helped deliver growth and new job opportunities, and a Constitutionalist who has never backed down when it comes to protecting the rights of all North Texans.

**MARCELL STRBICH IS RUNNING FOR

[**strbichforohio.com**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b903f8756e&e=5c740fa3e2)
Many across Ohio already know: Marcell is the right person for this job. He’s a combat veteran, devoted family man, God-fearing patriot, and a proven election integrity advocate. Marcell has been instrumental in drafting nearly every meaningful election integrity bill proposed in Ohio—legislation that’s been deliberately ignored by two consecutive General Assemblies.

Until we see real campaign finance reform, grassroots Ohioans are going to need to dig deep, open their wallets, and be willing to make a personal financial commitment.

_**"In politics, money talks, and campaign filings are how that message gets delivered—loud and clear."**_

It’s important for political candidates to show strong fundraising success in their required government filings because, WHETHER WE LIKE IT OR NOT, money signals momentum, viability, and power—both to insiders and voters. Here’s why it matters:
* Big fundraising numbers make a candidate look like a serious contender. Media, party leaders, donors, and voters all use these filings to gauge who’s competitive and worth taking seriously. Strong fundraising hauls get picked up in headlines: “Candidate Raises $250K in First Quarter”. This creates free publicity and positions the campaign as rising or dominant.
* Party insiders, elected officials, and political organizations often withhold endorsements until they see who can raise money and win. High fundraising can trigger snowball support from power brokers who want to back a winner. Strong numbers can scare off challengers, who may not want to go up against a financially strong opponent.
* Grassroots supporters want to feel they’re backing a campaign that has momentum and a path to victory. Public fundraising reports serve as a psychological boost to volunteers and potential new donors.
* Fundraising equals field operations, advertising, legal support, and more. A candidate who’s raising well is seen as having the infrastructure to compete.

Fundraising filings are more than compliance—they’re performance scorecards. They influence media, endorsements, donor psychology, and even the ballot itself.

**Marcell's first deadline is June 30th.** Shortly after that, his filings are due and the public, including potential donors & the media, will gauge Marcell's financial competitiveness.

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zejfns09t1bmbuibt5ekbn1l75og3mgspa2rirl8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chgeap72c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1e2225r9upsklu4jjape5b078ib7uojdh9r1ouo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chgeap72c5h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5r7pb6jeibt4js4hmcc2u85j0ubster9v4i88eo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chgeap72c5h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
