The Senate, through Senator "Not-So-Based" Mike Lee's ([@BasedMikeLee](https://substack.com/redirect/48826dcd-376e-471e-9bc8-03b8736306ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) reconciliation bill, [plans to liquidate](https://substack.com/redirect/cefdb9aa-23a2-45d9-a088-7ec6eff98136?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 21.7 million acres of Idaho public lands.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd6d900b-11da-405e-aadf-ec457bbf0d0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This isn't a "housing fix."
It's a calculated heist, handing our mountains, rivers, and forests to parasites like BlackRock or Simplot.
They'll fence off our fields, lock up our streams, and turn the Sawtooth Range, Owyhees, and Frank Church into private estates for global elites (think, Blaine County).
_**That 's one-fifth of Idaho's public lands, erased for tax breaks for the ultra-rich. **_
"Let the FEDS manage the land!" (they say)
"The states will sell it the instant they control it!" (they say)
Uh, really?
_Idaho manages 2.4 million acres of endowment lands and hasn 't sold them to developers. _
The myth that state control "automagically" means privatization is a boogeyman pushed to justify this federal betrayal.
Idaho protects its heritage.
The feds?
They want to shove this through with 30-day land nominations, 60-day sales, and zero public input. It's a rigged game, designed to kill our access to the wild. Billionaires have already bought up hundreds of thousands of acres and blocked public access with gates and armed guards.
How many more will follow?
This sell-off guts Idaho's outdoor economy and our identity. No more hunting in the St. Joe! No more fishing the Henry's Fork! Just "Private Property" signs for hedge fund lords. Idaho isn't their playground. It's our home. Senators Risch ([@SenatorRisch](https://substack.com/redirect/5ede3f4d-56b9-4cea-8079-621cb92c903f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and Crapo (@SenatorCrapo) need to **kill this bill.**
Keep Idaho's lands for Idahoans, not corporate raiders.

Restoring SALT would bring real tax relief to Nassau’s middle class, but Blakeman hasn’t lifted a finger. While he claims to care about taxpayers, his actions say otherwise.

Blakeman promised to lower taxes and fix the assessment system. He’s done neither. He promised economic growth, but delivered broken deals and lost billions in investment. He promised to prioritize public safety, but played politics with funding for first responders. And now, when Nassau residents need his voice on SALT, we get nothing but silence.

**[Sign the petition and demand Bruce Blakeman stand up for Nassau homeowners and push to restore the SALT deduction.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109747248/552110672/-601475724?contactdata=0duSqAdR3AHUu3p4yBJ+2glJ68AwucU7/3wiEQP3wSCDCpIrGGW16nO/lJJuElh5HreDXJrlG8QoWFNayQ6azMy1uLrAAJP5RR5G4/gNXD0=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTYyMTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTcxY2UxYzItOGI0Yi1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=enWfOl9EdceRBwWrcZbmsr31MZRoJRN6lX-6B7trazo=&emci=dc1b6b4d-7c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=571ce1c2-8b4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=17551891)**

This week the Israeli government preemptively attacked Iran. But it would be a mistake to assume Netanyahu's unilateral decision to attack is something he just now concocted. Instead, this week is the culmination of more than three decades of disinformation from Netanyahu against Iran and other regional nations to expand his and Israel's power. Disinformation that has led to mass destruction, devastation, and death of countless innocent people. And unless the United Nations truly stands United to uphold international human rights law and stop the Israeli government from continuing its attacks, we risk escalation into a global conflict. One that may culminate in the use of nuclear weapons. This is not hyperbole. It is a tragically viable reality based on the facts at hand that corporate media continues to ignore.
**Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..SVNwJtEWDQYbKaOamYpQv0Yx79IPtEZ9nv3VTopv0Q0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=165911424)
## The History
Since the 1990s, Netanyahu has been the world's most persistent prophet of doom about Iran's alleged nuclear ambitions, repeatedly claiming "_we are just months away_ " from an Iranian bomb. Yet he has never once been correct. As is well [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/0e6769d7-ef5f-42c8-9e52-2bc96ddd4f6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> In 1992, when he was a 42-year-old Knesset member, Benjamin Netanyahu raised concerns about Iran's nuclear threat, stating, "Iran is close to producing a nuclear weapon within three to five years, and this threat needs to be uprooted by an international front led by the U.S." In 1995, in his book, he discussed Iran's nuclear threat and emphasized that it was a vital issue for Israel.
Overall, Netanyahu made these claims at least in 1992, in 1995, in 1996, in 2009, in 2012, again in 2015, and numerous times since then. Each time, his predictions were dead wrong. But Iran wasn't his only target. Indeed, as you watch the clip below, note how Netanyahu seems to blanket label all nations in the Middle East as terror nations.
In 2002, Benjamin Netanyahu sat before the U.S. Congress and did something that has since defined the last two decades of global instability: he sold a war. "_If you take out Saddam_ ," he said, "_I guarantee you that it will have enormous positive reverberations on the region_." Netanyahu went on to claim that dismantling Afghanistan, then Iraq, would then allow overtaking Iran as well.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0684a493-730a-4e81-bcfd-842829a34577?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
History has shown that Netanyahu was wrong on every front. Without exception. Those "_reverberations_ " he praised, as history has made painfully clear, included the deaths of hundreds of thousands Iraqis, the rise of Daesh (ISIS), the destabilization of Syria and Libya, and the displacement of tens of millions across the Middle East and North Africa. But that was always Netanyahu's goal--it wasn't peace, it was power. [A landmark study in 2016 found that such wars have resulted in the preventable killing of more than 4 million Muslim civilians](https://substack.com/redirect/e5df8ab3-c552-4ed2-9930-fe5af2ef1227?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Does this sound like justice and peace?
And if you think Netanyahu ever apologized for this catastrophic propaganda--one that cost trillions of dollars and shattered countless lives--think again. Instead, he has only doubled down and yet continues to double down with his latest preemptive attacks. His propaganda claims notwithstanding, Netanyahu exerted his power to vehemently oppose the 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), also known as the Iran Nuclear Deal. Meanwhile, the actual experts--the IAEA, the world's leading nuclear watchdog--confirmed that Iran was fully compliant with JCPOA. This included the requirement of complete transparency and access to their facilities for inspection and observation.
But Netanyahu opposed it anyway. And then he took it a step further.
Thanks to his lobbying and Donald Trump's impulsive recklessness, the United States exited that deal in 2018. What followed? Iran's nuclear program resumed. Tensions in the region escalated. And the progress made through diplomacy has now deteriorated under the threat of escalating war--all thanks to Netanyahu's injustices.

## The Present
At every moment over the last 30+ years, Netanyahu has taken every opportunity to spread disinformation about regional nations, advocated for war and violence including against civilians, and is now launching preemptive attacks against Iran. Now, with no regard for international law, Netanyahu has led Israel in a unilateral and preemptive military strike on Iran.
Let us be crystal clear about what this means: A sitting head of state, [already charged by the International Criminal Court for war crimes against Palestinians in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/45599766-4b56-4e74-869f-d90e39abd254?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is now bombing another sovereign nation without provocation and with no credible justification. This is not self-defense. This is impunity in action. This is what happens when the international community turns a blind eye to genocide. When you let one atrocity go unanswered, you do not avoid conflict--you invite the next one.
Thus, we are here in this dire circumstance now for two reasons.
One, because for the past 20 months, the Israeli government has executed a genocidal siege on Gaza, [killing by some estimates over 224,000 Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/6fbe0eee-9b82-4b13-a2fa-bd09e2d613d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--most of them women and children. [They have deliberately bombed hospitals, schools, bakeries, and refugee camps](https://substack.com/redirect/66b302f6-1882-447a-9283-a980202b3f44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They've weaponized famine and deprived an entire population of food, water, and medicine. And they have faced zero consequences.
And two, for the last 30 years, Netanyahu has advocated (successfully) for more war and destruction in the region--and the United States has continued to arm him to do as he pleases. And he has faced zero consequences.
And the so-called international community? They've responded with toothless _statements_. With faux _concern_. With empty _calls for restraint_. All while continuing to ship billions in weapons to the very regime under ICC investigation for war crimes and crimes against humanity.
Therefore, what Netanyahu has now done in attacking Iran preemptively is no surprise. It is the logical next step of a credibly accused war criminal who ([while also facing corruption charges in Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/02e3b4ae-cdc6-4ac8-ab79-3e596a4e63f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) has faced no consequences for his decades of injustices and disinformation. If we do not stop him now, we are endorsing a global doctrine of preemptive aggression by rogue states, and dismantling the post-WWII framework of international law. What, pray tell, is the substantive difference between Putin preemptively attacking Ukraine and Netanyahu preemptively attacking Iran? Both claim to do so under propagandized claims of self-defense.
And if we have learned nothing else from WWI and WWII, regional aggression quickly expands into global war and pulls in countless more nations. That is the fate we relegate ourselves to if we do not stop Netanyahu's recklessness immediately.
Therefore, the United Nations, the ICC, the ICJ, and every nation that claims to value human rights must take swift and unified action. This means sanctions. This means investigations. This means prosecutions. This means stopping all arms sales to Israel until it complies with international law and ends the occupation and siege of Gaza, and stops preemptive attacks on Iran.
We desperately need diplomacy and accountability, not more destruction.

## Media Complicity
Finally, corporate media must stop its complicity in whitewashing Netanyahu's crimes and violations of international law. For example, over the last few days The New York Times has published the below grotesque excuses for journalism. Mid East History Phd and scholar Assal Rad [posted these side-by-side comparisons](https://substack.com/redirect/5942b6f4-2f83-422e-93f2-efa8f9b902ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of how the New York Times frames Israel's preemptive attacks on Iran vs Iran's retaliatory attacks on Israel.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca74aa1f-b923-40b3-8816-e7380dcb14cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now, compare these above NYT headlines--which frame everything in defense of Israel's justifications and Netanyahu's legacy while wholly ignoring the devastation to Iranian civilians--with the below headlines, which fully humanize Israelis and demonizes Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be0d9fce-0c9f-4a12-a7e0-b01c66e05a53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The UK Guardian added this indefensible headline to whitewash the Israeli government's war crimes. Apparently, because Israel is _also_ attacking Iran, Israel is somehow now less obligated to stop committing the war crime of genocide and starvation of Palestinians. Simply reckless.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4d42d510-cd8b-47a2-ac14-8aa8e3d70083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And the New York Post went full propaganda, insinuating Iran initiated the attack, as opposed to the fact that Israel preemptively attacked Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/13446a31-2e41-41b7-bc5e-2145b6f8511b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The above are just a snapshot of the full court press corporate media is engaging in to justify preemptive attacks by Israel against Iran. I am not Iranian, nor am I an Iran apologist--I am a human rights lawyer who upholds justice above all else. And the facts are clear that Israel is the aggressor and must be held accountable per international law. Consider the facts:
* **Nuclear Weapons:**
* Iran does not have nuclear weapons--[as attested to by the United States government even as recently as late March 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/f200f3bb-2fc2-4812-8778-80bdf5a47856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Meanwhile, [Israel does have up to 200 nuclear weapons](https://substack.com/redirect/6ddd6529-524b-4dc1-b122-928e5b0fe9df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **IAEA Inspections:**
* Despite not having nuclear weapons, Iran has repeatedly opened its facilities and its countries for inspection by the IAEA and consistently passed inspections.
* Despite having hundreds of nuclear weapons, Israel refuses to open its facilities to the IAEA.
* **NPT:**
* Despite not having nuclear weapons, Iran is a signatory to Treaty on Nuclear Non-Proliferation (NPT).
* Despite having nuclear weapons, Israel refuses to sign the NPT.
* **Iran Nuclear Deal:**
* [Iran signed and fully abided by the Iran Nuclear Deal](https://substack.com/redirect/f6b4e522-4c5f-40b1-a429-2e1f9ec1361b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as the IAEA confirmed.
* Israel vehemently opposed the deal and worked to successfully convince the United States to unilaterally break the deal.
* **First Strike and[Proportionality](https://substack.com/redirect/ac76d6cd-2eb3-455c-a7dd-3c7da4de787e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): **
* Israel committed the first strike on Iran, which have killed more than 128 people, and injured more than 900, so far.
* Iran has only conducted retaliatory strikes, which have killed 10 people, and injured around 100.

If the above five scenarios were reversed, we would unanimously, universally, unhesitatingly, and correctly recognize Iran as the instigator, the aggressor, and the one at fault. Yet, even though all of the above points to the Israeli government's insistence on war over peace, crime over justice, and death over democracy--somehow they are the victim in all this. Does this make any sense to you?

## Conclusion
To be clear, this week the IAEA [ruled that Iran is in breach of it's nuclear obligations](https://substack.com/redirect/5e9a34a8-d036-4318-9d63-d5f5b40792ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--now after the United States government breached and broke the terms of the Iran Nuclear Deal. And meanwhile, the Israeli government remains far from the model example, given they still refuse to sign the NPT, still refuse to let IAEA inspectors evaluate Israel's nuclear program, and still engaged in a preemptive strike on Iran.
So now, we have a nuclear powered rogue state in Israel launching preemptive attacks against Iran--after forcing the elimination of a nuclear deal that was working successfully to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. A deal that the [Iranian government still committed to returning to in 2019, despite the U.S. breach, if the United States again committed](https://substack.com/redirect/4ec38e15-9d38-466d-9d3a-20fd79132d58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and the United States again refused. And thus in response, the Iranian government is now moving towards the potential of building a nuclear weapon. What else could this possibly lead to _but_ nuclear war if not curtailed? A nuclear arms race is not the path to peace, it is quintessentially the path to global destruction. And that is what we face if we do not stop this escalation immediately.
For those seeking justice above war, the lesson is clear: when war criminals are not stopped, they escalate. When genocide is ignored, it spreads. And when nuclear non-proliferation deals are unilaterally breached by the United States, we cannot be surprised when the other party also refuses to abide by its terms.
Finally, this is a prime and painful example of why independent, people-powered human rights advocacy is more essential than ever. Corporate media has shown us, time and again, that it will bend to the will of the powerful and sanitize atrocity if it protects profits and access. But we do not have to accept that. In fact, we must reject it. We can demand justice. We can amplify the truth. We can hold war criminals accountable--if we stay organized, informed, and relentless. That's what I aim to do with _Let 's Address This_. Therefore, if you find value in this work, I invite you to support it--by subscribing, by sharing, and by standing with me in this fight for truth over tyranny. Help me continue to provide real time, factually verified, and justice focused analysis on these key human rights issues that impact us all. Because the future of human rights depends on what we choose to do right now. And we must choose and elevate justice above all else.

Israel's preemptive attack on Iran is not a surprise--it is the first step to ongoing atrocity that risks nuclear war if we do not stop it immediately | | | Jun 17 | | | | | | | | | | | | This week the Israeli government preemptively attacked Iran. But it would be a mistake to assume Netanyahu's unilateral decision to attack is something he just now concocted. Instead, this week is the culmination of more than three decades of disinformation from Netanyahu against Iran and other regional nations to expand his and Israel's power. Disinformation that has led to mass destruction, devastation, and death of countless innocent people. And unless the United Nations truly stands United to uphold international human rights law and stop the Israeli government from continuing its attacks, we risk escalation into a global conflict. One that may culminate in the use of nuclear weapons. This is not hyperbole. It is a tragically viable reality based on the facts at hand that corporate media continues to ignore. Let 's Address This. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. The History Since the 1990s, Netanyahu has been the world's most persistent prophet of doom about Iran's alleged nuclear ambitions, repeatedly claiming "we are just months away " from an Iranian bomb. Yet he has never once been correct. As is well : In 1992, when he was a 42-year-old Knesset member, Benjamin Netanyahu raised concerns about Iran's nuclear threat, stating, "Iran is close to producing a nuclear weapon within three to five years, and this threat needs to be uprooted by an international front led by the U.S." In 1995, in his book, he discussed Iran's nuclear threat and emphasized that it was a vital issue for Israel. Overall, Netanyahu made these claims at least in 1992, in 1995, in 1996, in 2009, in 2012, again in 2015, and numerous times since then. Each time, his predictions were dead wrong. But Iran wasn't his only target. Indeed, as you watch the clip below, note how Netanyahu seems to blanket label all nations in the Middle East as terror nations. In 2002, Benjamin Netanyahu sat before the U.S. Congress and did something that has since defined the last two decades of global instability: he sold a war. "If you take out Saddam ," he said, "I guarantee you that it will have enormous positive reverberations on the region." Netanyahu went on to claim that dismantling Afghanistan, then Iraq, would then allow overtaking Iran as well. History has shown that Netanyahu was wrong on every front. Without exception. Those "reverberations " he praised, as history has made painfully clear, included the deaths of hundreds of thousands Iraqis, the rise of Daesh (ISIS), the destabilization of Syria and Libya, and the displacement of tens of millions across the Middle East and North Africa. But that was always Netanyahu's goal--it wasn't peace, it was power. . Does this sound like justice and peace? And if you think Netanyahu ever apologized for this catastrophic propaganda--one that cost trillions of dollars and shattered countless lives--think again. Instead, he has only doubled down and yet continues to double down with his latest preemptive attacks. His propaganda claims notwithstanding, Netanyahu exerted his power to vehemently oppose the 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), also known as the Iran Nuclear Deal. Meanwhile, the actual experts--the IAEA, the world's leading nuclear watchdog--confirmed that Iran was fully compliant with JCPOA. This included the requirement of complete transparency and access to their facilities for inspection and observation. But Netanyahu opposed it anyway. And then he took it a step further. Thanks to his lobbying and Donald Trump's impulsive recklessness, the United States exited that deal in 2018. What followed? Iran's nuclear program resumed. Tensions in the region escalated. And the progress made through diplomacy has now deteriorated under the threat of escalating war--all thanks to Netanyahu's injustices. The Present At every moment over the last 30+ years, Netanyahu has taken every opportunity to spread disinformation about regional nations, advocated for war and violence including against civilians, and is now launching preemptive attacks against Iran. Now, with no regard for international law, Netanyahu has led Israel in a unilateral and preemptive military strike on Iran. Let us be crystal clear about what this means: A sitting head of state, , is now bombing another sovereign nation without provocation and with no credible justification. This is not self-defense. This is impunity in action. This is what happens when the international community turns a blind eye to genocide. When you let one atrocity go unanswered, you do not avoid conflict--you invite the next one. Thus, we are here in this dire circumstance now for two reasons. One, because for the past 20 months, the Israeli government has executed a genocidal siege on Gaza, of them women and children. . They've weaponized famine and deprived an entire population of food, water, and medicine. And they have faced zero consequences. And two, for the last 30 years, Netanyahu has advocated (successfully) for more war and destruction in the region--and the United States has continued to arm him to do as he pleases. And he has faced zero consequences. And the so-called international community? They've responded with toothless statements. With faux concern. With empty calls for restraint. All while continuing to ship billions in weapons to the very regime under ICC investigation for war crimes and crimes against humanity. Therefore, what Netanyahu has now done in attacking Iran preemptively is no surprise. It is the logical next step of a credibly accused war criminal who () has faced no consequences for his decades of injustices and disinformation. If we do not stop him now, we are endorsing a global doctrine of preemptive aggression by rogue states, and dismantling the post-WWII framework of international law. What, pray tell, is the substantive difference between Putin preemptively attacking Ukraine and Netanyahu preemptively attacking Iran? Both claim to do so under propagandized claims of self-defense. And if we have learned nothing else from WWI and WWII, regional aggression quickly expands into global war and pulls in countless more nations. That is the fate we relegate ourselves to if we do not stop Netanyahu's recklessness immediately. Therefore, the United Nations, the ICC, the ICJ, and every nation that claims to value human rights must take swift and unified action. This means sanctions. This means investigations. This means prosecutions. This means stopping all arms sales to Israel until it complies with international law and ends the occupation and siege of Gaza, and stops preemptive attacks on Iran. We desperately need diplomacy and accountability, not more destruction. This research takes work and needs your support. If you 're finding value in this scholarship, please join us as a paid subscriber. Media Complicity Finally, corporate media must stop its complicity in whitewashing Netanyahu's crimes and violations of international law. For example, over the last few days The New York Times has published the below grotesque excuses for journalism. Mid East History Phd and scholar Assal Rad of how the New York Times frames Israel's preemptive attacks on Iran vs Iran's retaliatory attacks on Israel. | | ---|---|--- Now, compare these above NYT headlines--which frame everything in defense of Israel's justifications and Netanyahu's legacy while wholly ignoring the devastation to Iranian civilians--with the below headlines, which fully humanize Israelis and demonizes Iran. | | ---|---|--- The UK Guardian added this indefensible headline to whitewash the Israeli government's war crimes. Apparently, because Israel is also attacking Iran, Israel is somehow now less obligated to stop committing the war crime of genocide and starvation of Palestinians. Simply reckless. | | ---|---|--- And the New York Post went full propaganda, insinuating Iran initiated the attack, as opposed to the fact that Israel preemptively attacked Iran. | | ---|---|--- The above are just a snapshot of the full court press corporate media is engaging in to justify preemptive attacks by Israel against Iran. I am not Iranian, nor am I an Iran apologist--I am a human rights lawyer who upholds justice above all else. And the facts are clear that Israel is the aggressor and must be held accountable per international law. Consider the facts: Nuclear Weapons: Iran does not have nuclear weapons--. Meanwhile, . IAEA Inspections: Despite not having nuclear weapons, Iran has repeatedly opened its facilities and its countries for inspection by the IAEA and consistently passed inspections. Despite having hundreds of nuclear weapons, Israel refuses to open its facilities to the IAEA. NPT: Despite not having nuclear weapons, Iran is a signatory to Treaty on Nuclear Non-Proliferation (NPT). Despite having nuclear weapons, Israel refuses to sign the NPT. Iran Nuclear Deal: , as the IAEA confirmed. Israel vehemently opposed the deal and worked to successfully convince the United States to unilaterally break the deal. First Strike and: Israel committed the first strike on Iran, which have killed more than 128 people, and injured more than 900, so far. Iran has only conducted retaliatory strikes, which have killed 10 people, and injured around 100. If the above five scenarios were reversed, we would unanimously, universally, unhesitatingly, and correctly recognize Iran as the instigator, the aggressor, and the one at fault. Yet, even though all of the above points to the Israeli government's insistence on war over peace, crime over justice, and death over democracy--somehow they are the victim in all this. Does this make any sense to you? Conclusion To be clear, this week the IAEA after the United States government breached and broke the terms of the Iran Nuclear Deal. And meanwhile, the Israeli government remains far from the model example, given they still refuse to sign the NPT, still refuse to let IAEA inspectors evaluate Israel's nuclear program, and still engaged in a preemptive strike on Iran. So now, we have a nuclear powered rogue state in Israel launching preemptive attacks against Iran--after forcing the elimination of a nuclear deal that was working successfully to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. A deal that the the United States again refused. And thus in response, the Iranian government is now moving towards the potential of building a nuclear weapon. What else could this possibly lead to but nuclear war if not curtailed? A nuclear arms race is not the path to peace, it is quintessentially the path to global destruction. And that is what we face if we do not stop this escalation immediately. For those seeking justice above war, the lesson is clear: when war criminals are not stopped, they escalate. When genocide is ignored, it spreads. And when nuclear non-proliferation deals are unilaterally breached by the United States, we cannot be surprised when the other party also refuses to abide by its terms. Finally, this is a prime and painful example of why independent, people-powered human rights advocacy is more essential than ever. Corporate media has shown us, time and again, that it will bend to the will of the powerful and sanitize atrocity if it protects profits and access. But we do not have to accept that. In fact, we must reject it. We can demand justice. We can amplify the truth. We can hold war criminals accountable--if we stay organized, informed, and relentless. That's what I aim to do with Let 's Address This. Therefore, if you find value in this work, I invite you to support it--by subscribing, by sharing, and by standing with me in this fight for truth over tyranny. Help me continue to provide real time, factually verified, and justice focused analysis on these key human rights issues that impact us all. #### **Trump Mandate and Congressional Action Target Ranked-Choice Voting**

---
|
---
#### WASHINGTON, D.C. – The first major salvo came in March 2025, when the President signed the Executive Order on Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections.
#### This order initiated a necessary increase in the Executive Branch's oversight of federal elections, demanding stricter requirements for voter registration and mail-in ballots. While advocates for the flawed RCV system nervously view the order as a sign of greater federal involvement, patriots see it as a critical first step toward a complete prohibition of RCV, with many believing a specific executive ban is imminent.
#### A Unified Front to Stop a Corrupt System President Trump's executive action is bolstered by a growing movement in Congress to outlaw RCV at the federal level. Lawmakers have introduced powerful legislation, including the One Vote One Choice Act (H.R. 3704) and the Preventing Ranked Choice Corruption Act (H.R. 3040), to explicitly ban this undemocratic voting method in all federal elections. This legislative push is a direct response to RCV's inherent flaws.
#### Election integrity advocates have proven the system:
#### Deliberately Confuses Voters: RCV's complex ranking system is a nightmare for voters, creating chaos at the ballot box and leading to thousands of invalidated "exhausted" ballots where citizens' votes are simply thrown out.
#### Destroys the "One Person, One Vote" Principle: RCV violates the sacred American principle of one clear vote per person by creating a confusing process of vote redistribution that ultimately manufactures winners who were not the first choice of the most voters.
#### Is Fiscally Irresponsible: Alaska’s disastrous experiment with RCV in 2022 cost taxpayers over $11 million—a staggering 328% increase—squandered on opaque software and attempts to explain an inexplicable system.
#### Battleground DC: Congress Fights Back The fight against RCV has now reached the nation's capital. In 2024, voters in the District of Columbia passed Initiative 83, a measure to install RCV in local elections.
#### However, leaders in Congress are refusing to allow this flawed system to take root in Washington. While the initial window for a simple disapproval of the law has passed, RCV opponents have signaled their clear intent to nullify the measure using the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act (H.R. 4563).
#### This crucial legislation will be used to explicitly ban RCV in the District, making the capital a model for election integrity, not a showcase for a corrupt voting experiment. Alaska: A National Warning of RCV's Failure The urgency of these actions is underscored by the catastrophe of RCV in Alaska.
#### The system, imposed on the state by narrow margins, has been a disaster, producing distorted results that many argue are not reflective of the voters' true will.
#### The widespread opposition was made clear when a 2024 citizen-led initiative to repeal RCV came within a handful of votes of succeeding after 2-3 weeks of counting, proving the public's rejection of this failed experiment.
#### From the White House to the halls of Congress to the 17 States that have already banned RCV, leaders are taking decisive action. The message is clear: the movement to restore the 'one person, one vote' principle is strong, and the effort to ban the undemocratic RCV system from American elections has never been more critical.

#### But what if the next Enron wasn’t a corporation?
What if it was your own government?

**What happens when a state quietly reallocates tens of billions of dollars meant for its citizens—without a vote, without consent, and without accountability?**
#### We follow the money—through shadowy nonprofits, bloated bureaucracies, and politically connected networks like **Arabella Advisors** , **Alaska Venture Fund** , and the **1630 Fund**.

#### **Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. This film asks the billion-dollar question: What happens when a state quietly reallocates tens of billions of dollars meant for its citizens—without a vote, without consent, and without accountability? We follow the money—through shadowy nonprofits, bloated bureaucracies, and politically connected networks like Arabella Advisors , Alaska Venture Fund , and the 1630 Fund. It’s a financial betrayal not buried in spreadsheets—but broadcast in silence. $25 billion gone —not from shareholders this time, but from the people of Alaska. This is The Permanent Short. More announcements coming soon. Thank you for being part of this journey. | Now we have 108 supporters for “Frozen Odds” Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process. Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down? | | | | Follow Me On X @907Honest | | Phil Izon 12110 Business Blvd Ste A06 Box #113 Eagle River 99577 United States

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Donald Trump‘s move toward oligarchy and authoritarianism has created an
unprecedented moment in modern American history. We must respond in an
unprecedented way. Status quo politics is not good enough.

We need to elect candidates all over this country who have the guts not
only to stand up to Trumpism, but to take on the monied interests and
fight for a working class that has been ignored for far too long.

One of those candidates is our friend State Rep. Donavan McKinney, who
just over a month ago announced he was running for Congress in Michigan’s
13th Congressional District.

Donavan is a born-and-raised working class product of Detroit. Before he
was a State Rep., he was a champion and leader for labor rights and
climate justice across Michigan. Serving on Michigan’s first-ever
Environmental Justice Council and as a leader at SEIU Healthcare Michigan,
Donavan understands the obstacles everyday people in his state and across
the country are facing just to be able to drink clean water and earn a
living wage.

In the State House, he has continued that work, leading projects to
replace lead pipes in Michigan, fighting to ensure every child in Michigan
can receive a quality public education, bringing justice to the criminal
legal system, pushing for a robust, quality public transit system, and
securing the rights of unions and workers. He has worked to lower costs
and increase affordability for the people, representing the poorest State
House district in Michigan with a median income of less than $20K.

And Donavan knows that the greatest obstacle to delivering Medicare for
All, a Green New Deal, and a living wage for the people is the
overwhelming influence of big money in politics.

Donavan is running in a Democratic primary for Congress against a wealthy,
self-funding incumbent. If he is going to win he needs our help and that
is why I am asking you to donate to Donavan’s campaign — $27 or whatever
you can afford:

$27 because Donavan will be the kind of progressive voice we need in
Congress if we are going to stand up to Trump, protect our democratic way
of life, and create an economy that works for working families — not just
the rich.

$27 because Donavan will be taking on not just Republicans, not just
corporate interests, but the Democratic establishment as well.

$27 because we are all in this together, and Donavan needs us now if he is
going to win this race.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250617-dm?refcode=em20250617-36766&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=27&refcode2=36766_1203867_Uz6N2V&akid=36766%2E1203867%2EUz6N2V ]Please make a contribution of $27, or whatever you can afford today,
directly to Donavan McKinney’s campaign for Congress in Michigan. I am
very proud to support him in this race, and I hope you will as well.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250617-dm?refcode=em20250617-36766&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=27&refcode2=36766_1203867_Uz6N2V&akid=36766%2E1203867%2EUz6N2V ]Contribute $27

When we act collectively we have the ability not only to create a dynamic
progressive movement, but we will be able to transform our nation and
create a government that represents all of us, not just the people on top.
That’s the goal. Let’s do it.

In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

You don’t call law enforcement Nazis unless you’ve decided you don’t believe in laws. That’s what Tim Walz did. He compared ICE agents—Americans who risk their lives enforcing the law—to the Gestapo.

_**Let that sink in.
**_
**These aren’t slip-ups. This is the modern Left’s playbook:**
* Undermine the rule of law.

* Demonize law enforcement.

* Accuse ordinary Americans of extremism for wanting basic security.

_**And then they call you a radical.**_

I’m Adam Schwarze. **I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine who deployed nine times, including in Iraq and Africa, and I’m running for U.S. Senate to stop this madness. I didn’t spend 21 years defending this country just to come home and be called a Nazi by politicians who couldn’t even defend their own cities.**

While Minneapolis was burning in the summer of 2020,**Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, my opponent in the Minnesota Senate race** , was working on a lawsuit against the police. That tells you everything you need to know. **Democrats hide behind lawsuits and frivolous social media posts; Republicans rally behind the American flag and the men and women serving our communities in uniform.**

What they did to our cities was shameful. What they’re doing to our border is dangerous. And what they’re saying about veterans, police officers, and law-abiding citizens is disgusting.

So here’s the truth:
* Enforcing immigration law is not fascism. **It’s federal law.**

* Wanting to deport criminals who prey on Americans is not bigotry. **It’s basic decency.**

* Demanding accountability from a government that lets cities burn is not extreme. **It’s patriotism.**

clean_body: Tim Walz compared ICE agents - Americans who risk their lives enforcing the law - to the Gestapo. | Fellow Conservative, You don’t call law enforcement Nazis unless you’ve decided you don’t believe in laws. That’s what Tim Walz did. He compared ICE agents—Americans who risk their lives enforcing the law—to the Gestapo. Let that sink in. These aren’t slip-ups. This is the modern Left’s playbook: Undermine the rule of law. Demonize law enforcement. Accuse ordinary Americans of extremism for wanting basic security. And then they call you a radical. I’m Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine who deployed nine times, including in Iraq and Africa, and I’m running for U.S. Senate to stop this madness. I didn’t spend 21 years defending this country just to come home and be called a Nazi by politicians who couldn’t even defend their own cities. While Minneapolis was burning in the summer of 2020,Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, my opponent in the Minnesota Senate race , was working on a lawsuit against the police. That tells you everything you need to know. Democrats hide behind lawsuits and frivolous social media posts; Republicans rally behind the American flag and the men and women serving our communities in uniform. What they did to our cities was shameful. What they’re doing to our border is dangerous. And what they’re saying about veterans, police officers, and law-abiding citizens is disgusting. So here’s the truth: Enforcing immigration law is not fascism. It’s federal law. Wanting to deport criminals who prey on Americans is not bigotry. It’s basic decency. Demanding accountability from a government that lets cities burn is not extreme. It’s patriotism. If you're as outraged as I am, I need your help now. I'm starting out this race with no money and little name recognition - what I do have is a deep love of this country, and an exemplarily military record. I would be humbled if you could spare a few dollars today to ensure my campaign for the U.S. Senate gets off the ground. This is the battle. Right here. Right now. Tim Walz and his radical, militant left-wing lieutenant governor think they can shame us into silence. They think they can call us names until we stop pushing back. They are wrong. I didn’t come from wealth. I wasn’t groomed for politics. I earned everything —from my SEAL trident to my Harvard and Johns Hopkins degrees—through service and sacrifice. And I’m bringing that same grit to this pivotal U.S. Senate race. But I need reinforcements. And that starts with you, Fellow Conservative. If you’re tired of watching cities fall apart, borders erased, and law enforcement demonized. And if you’re tired of being told that loving your country makes you a villain, Because we’re not the extremists. We’re the ones standing between America and collapse. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Take heart
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
I know things seem tough right now.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2290%2E135344%2Eh5HGGR)

Friends -
I know things seem tough right now.
Every day we're reading stories about the Trump administration's efforts to change who we are as a country.
Every day we're seeing Republicans in Washington, D.C. try to mislead about the true intent of their efforts because they know they are terribly unpopular.
So what can we do?
First, please take heart.
The lessons on how to fight back can be found in what we did in Trump's first administration – the one place we say with a straight face that the country rose up, communicated, and succeeded was on the one thing he is trying to do today:
We fought back on his attempt to take away our health care.
Trump tried to repeal Obamacare. He ran on it. He was obsessed with it. And not only do we still have it, we expanded it.
How was that? Because we educated people – normal people who don't have time to doom-scroll or watch cable news.
We did that. And I want you to keep that in your mind because that is what we must do now.
It's what I am trying to do in rallies and town halls across Michigan and in content that reaches people nationally.
But I need your help to continue that work, because there are costs associated with those efforts, and obviously, we spent down our fundraising in order to win the election.
[**Can you please contribute $5, $50, or whatever you can afford to my campaign? I will put your donation to work organizing to stop Trump's efforts to take away our health care and to help elect Democrats in the next election.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june25.oGrjJM&refcode=em250617-1&t=2&akid=2290%2E135344%2Eh5HGGR)

## Army celebration roars, despite media coverage...
Everybody loves a good celebration.
And when it's honoring something truly great, that's even better.
That's exactly what we got this past weekend, including a big parade.
It wasn't just a great time -- it also gave us a taste of what's to come with next year's celebrations of America's 250th anniversary.
Next year's Fourth of July will mark 250 years since we became a nation.
And this weekend was a pretty great trial run for the celebration if you ask me.
It was a patriotic, all-American moment, honoring the Army and the million-plus soldiers who've sacrificed for our freedom.
But if you watched the coverage on a mainstream media network, you'd think it was something else entirely.
Let's just say the left and their media buddies are already warming up their spin machine--and it ain't pretty.
Let's break it down...

My updates from the last few weeks.

---
| | **A NOTE FROM CHRISSY**
---
| | **I voted "No" on the Republican budget bill**
---
Republicans in Congress just passed their so-called “One Big Beautiful Bill,” which I, along with every single House Democrat, voted against. We tried to stop it by offering an endless stream of amendments in a 22-hour session. And we tried to stop it by urging, behind the scenes, our GOP colleagues to oppose it. This bill cuts SNAP, Medicaid, Pell benefits, and more for low-income Americans while making the rich even richer. The bill is now in the Senate, so we’ve turned our attention there, and I hope you will, too. If you haven’t already, please contact your Senators to urge them to vote no. This is far from a done deal, and your calls matter.
---
| | **Honoring the jan. 6 officers **
---
In 2022, Congress passed a law with bipartisan support to place a bronze plaque honoring the police officers who defended us and the U.S. Capitol on January 6. Congressional Republicans refuse to comply, and the reason they give, behind the scenes, is they are scared of angering President Trump. During Police Week this year, I joined my colleagues in a press conference to highlight GOP inaction and cowardice. A bronze plaque is a simple thing, but what it represents is everything.
---
| | **COFFEE WITH CONSTITUENTS & Town Halls**
---
One of my favorite parts of the job is hearing directly from members of our PA-06 community – whether it's comments or questions about what’s happening here locally or what's happening down in Washington. I held my 99th town hall last week and will be hosting my 100th soon. My office also recently held another Coffee with Constituents, a mobile office hour style event where we are available in different communities, and are doing another one soon. We aim to do both town halls and Coffees with Constituents monthly.
---
| | **Congressional app challenge**
---
I'm excited to share that our 2025 Congressional App Challenge is now live. In full support of STEM education, each year, we challenge students in our districts to create and submit their original apps to be put on display in the U.S. Capitol building. This challenge is a nationwide event, open to students of all experience levels throughout our district. Learn how you can participate by visiting [**https://CongressionalAppChallenge.us**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109753137/552128310/-628956261?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjk5M2YyNC05NDRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nPcBdQDIz3zuCW1Y178v0kX3K-34nbfWWxJsva707Bc=&emci=b6c5d0f7-dd46-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=f6993f24-944b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=21278485).
---
| | **Bipartisan Legislation Supporting Public Servants**
---
Last month, I hosted a roundtable discussion with local law enforcement officers and first responders focused on recruitment, retention, public service, and funding challenges they face. I reintroduced the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Payment Completion Fairness Act, with Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick (R-PA), to close loopholes and simplify student loan forgiveness for all public servants.
---
| | **Research Advancing to Market Production for Innovators Act**
---
I'm proud to share that I reintroduced the bipartisan Research Advancing to Market Production (RAMP) for Innovators Act – a bill that would help innovative small businesses commercialize their technical counterparts. Not only would this legislation streamline federal support for American small businesses, it would also allow entrepreneurs to accelerate the timeline to bring their products to market to ensure our innovative entrepreneurs can succeed.
---
Thank you for your support, Derek.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy

| | | _**- A Personal Note from Congresswoman Young Kim - **_
Dear, Peter,

body:

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8674%2E5257348%2ELYWJMK)
Derek,
**I’m Chris Pappas, Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.** Adam said I could reach out to you today with a special message about Pride.
I’ve always admired Harvey Milk. He changed history and paved the way for folks like me when he became one of the first openly gay elected officials in America fifty years ago.
Since then, there have been numerous other examples of LGBTQ+ leaders elected across the country, like Tammy Baldwin, Pete Buttigieg, and Sarah McBride, just to name a few.
These leaders have broken down barriers, stood up to discrimination, and fought for a vision of our country where every American can live with safety, dignity, and equality.
I’m proud to be a part of that legacy — and to carry the torch forward with this campaign.
**If elected I’ll be the first openly gay man to ever serve in the U.S. Senate.** And I will work as hard as I can when I’m in the Senate to ensure everyone — no matter who they are or who they love — has the freedom and opportunity to thrive, whether that means owning a home, starting a family, opening a small business, or anything else in between.
This Pride Month, I’m asking for your support to power this grassroots campaign. We’re on the verge of making history, but we can’t win this fight without a strong foundation.
Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans would like nothing more than to flip this pivotal Senate seat red next November – but if we fight back, we can stop them in their tracks.
[**Are you with me, Derek? Donate $10 now to my campaign and Adam Schiff. subject: President Trump only has 18 months.
body:
My friend, President Trump only has 18 months left until the midterm elections.

| |

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, **[I’m writing to you today because I need your help to secure our elections once and for all and keep America on the path to greatness.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zpfojviq941rikkmnq11uvl7p0slihf9afrme6ho_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chie2o31chh2bs)** My friend, President Trump only has 18 months left until the midterm elections. **That’s 18 months to push through as much of his America First agenda as he can while we have a majority in the House and Senate.** I don’t mean to be pessimistic about our chances in the midterms. I’m just being a realist.Historically, the party not in the White House wins control of the House of Representatives in the midterms. That means, in just 18 months we could be right back where we started if young radicals like Hakeem Jeffries and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez regain power and start blocking every one of our efforts. **[That’s why our election integrity efforts must be a priority right now._election integrity efforts_ must be a priority right now.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z07d41cuj0rpkak5e93ektgi4lrjoh1sbstun0r0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chie2o31chh2bs)**_If we can’t get the SAVE Act through the Senate...__ _ _If we can’t cement President Trump’s “Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections” executive order through legislation...__ __If we can’t stop non-citizens from being counted towards the apportionment of congressional seats and electoral vote counts..._ ...the Left will be free to use every dirty trick in the book for the midterms in 2026, the presidential election in 2028... and beyond.[**AMAC Action, will never give up. But my friend, as a strong conservative senior, we NEED you right there beside us.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zmgd54ud60fjk0aeb1h3cg5jr10cm05i80u4ph30_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chie2o31chh2bs) My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action****is****the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.** **We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.****Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.** **And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the****is****sues.** Friend, with the support of patriotic seniors like you, in just the past few months AMAC Action has been able to:
---
** Hold 100 meetings with Congress -- this year alone! And send 40 Letters of Support on a variety of issues that are important to you including opposing benefits for non-citizens. ** Support President Trump’s executive order “Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections.” This order requires that all mail-in and absentee ballots be received by Election Day, directs the DOJ to enforce laws prohibiting noncitizen voting, and instructs federal agencies to maintain accurate voter rolls. ** Answer the call from Speaker Johnson to mobilize our supporters and get 7,000 messages sent to Congress to help get the SAVE Act passed in the House of Representatives. The SAVE Act ensures only American citizens vote in American elections.** Launch calls-to-action in individual states to stop illegal immigrants from voting. ** And unite thousands of Americans around our “BAN NONCITIZEN VOTING” petition drive that calls for an amendment to the United States Constitution that expressly forbids illegal aliens from voting and from being counted in the census that determines congressional seats and electoral votes.
---
All our work is made possible by brave AMAC Action patriots. But with the stakes higher than ever, we need every conservative freedom fighter standing with us.That means YOU, friend.**[That’s why I hope you’ll click this link to support AMAC Action during this critical time for your sacred vote.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ze7q9qt6rfbq1cgd5u1m2i50rqfr8n8hsrm4vvbo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chie2o31chh2bs)** We’ve got our work cut out for us as we fight to stop the 11.5 million illegals Joe Biden and Kamala Harris let into our country from:
---
* voting in our elections
* taking benefits reserved for you
* being counted the same as citizens when it comes to apportioning seats in the House of Representatives
* and being counted as citizens when it comes to giving states electoral votes.

---
Letting illegals change the balance of power in Congress and the electoral college means your vote may be fully **canceled out in all future elections**.The Left thinks they can pull a fast one on the American people.You, me and AMAC Action... we can’t let up for one minute. **[And that’s why I hope you’ll pledge your support for AMAC Action with your very best gift today.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z49as17m2a9fiqs4jmvl17n87pel2e7lltfpurto_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chie2o31chh2bs)** AMAC Action is taking every step possible to secure our elections because no matter what issue you care about the most – inflation, crime, the 2nd Amendment, Social Security and Medicare solvency, even the right to life......if you and I don’t have a vote... none of it matters. **[That’s what makes your best gift to AMAC Action so important today.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zbcpdhv101prm9s03qd32ln783no7rn5kbpu7aa0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0chie2o31chh2bs)** So whatever critical amount you decide to return to help us secure our elections and your vote, please respond as soon as possible. We have an ambitious battle plan for the rest of the year—but first I must know that we have the resources to make it happen.I look forward to your response.
---

**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109759258/552148119/1328794144?refcode=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhjNWNiNmU1LTljNGItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WJnugF9vabIadNEb8l1dYgj5Zlzo9p-4Z1BE8EU2We0=&emci=23afbf5c-e54a-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=4823105)

I am coming to you with a very special announcement: **JanePAC is proud to endorse Adelita Grijalva for Congress in the high-stakes special election for Arizona’s 7th District!** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109759259/552148120/-2031514354?refcode=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhjNWNiNmU1LTljNGItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WJnugF9vabIadNEb8l1dYgj5Zlzo9p-4Z1BE8EU2We0=) Now more than ever, we urgently need fearless climate champions in Washington — leaders who will always put people over profit and fight like hell for real solutions. In Southern Arizona, the stakes couldn’t be higher: Extreme heat, scarce and contaminated water, and corporate polluters carving up the Sonoran Desert to line shareholders’ pockets are some of the daily threats to landscapes and communities. **Adelita is on the frontlines of the fight. She's exactly the kind of leader I had in mind when I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: someone who is rooted in her community and unafraid to take on fossil fuel interests.** **[That’s why I’m giving this race my ALL, and I need you with me. Adelita is facing a competitive Democratic primary on July 15th — less than a month away. Will you chip in any amount you can afford today to directly support Adelita’s campaign for Congress?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109759260/552148121/-2031514354?refcode=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhjNWNiNmU1LTljNGItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WJnugF9vabIadNEb8l1dYgj5Zlzo9p-4Z1BE8EU2We0=)** | [**DONATE TO ADELITA →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109759261/552148122/-2031514354?refcode=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.8c5cb6e5-9c4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhjNWNiNmU1LTljNGItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WJnugF9vabIadNEb8l1dYgj5Zlzo9p-4Z1BE8EU2We0=)

Adelita has proven again and again that when she takes on corporate polluters, she wins.
As a member of the Pima County Board of Supervisors, she blocked a petrochemical plant near Tucson, opposed a highway threatening public lands, stood up for Tribal sovereignty, and protected thousands of acres of open space.
Now, she's running for Congress to continue this critical work, and for her, this fight is deeply personal. Adelita is running to fill the seat held by her late father, Congressman Raúl Grijalva, who was one of our most vocal champions for environmental and social justice. In this moment when our environment and democracy face unprecedented threats, Adelita is carrying forward his legacy and bringing her own experience to the fight.
**But here's the reality: Special elections are often decided by just a handful of votes, and primary elections can be even closer.** Every dollar you contribute today could be the difference between sending a climate champion to Congress or watching another seat get taken over by corporate interests.
**[Adelita has spent her career standing up to powerful interests who put profits over people and planet. Now she needs our grassroots movement to show up for her. Can you chip in a few bucks today to power her campaign across the finish line? clean_body: A bold step forward — and a fight worth backing. | I am coming to you with a very special announcement: JanePAC is proud to endorse Adelita Grijalva for Congress in the high-stakes special election for Arizona’s 7th District! = Now more than ever, we urgently need fearless climate champions in Washington — leaders who will always put people over profit and fight like hell for real solutions. In Southern Arizona, the stakes couldn’t be higher: Extreme heat, scarce and contaminated water, and corporate polluters carving up the Sonoran Desert to line shareholders’ pockets are some of the daily threats to landscapes and communities. Adelita is on the frontlines of the fight. She's exactly the kind of leader I had in mind when I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: someone who is rooted in her community and unafraid to take on fossil fuel interests. = | = Adelita has proven again and again that when she takes on corporate polluters, she wins. As a member of the Pima County Board of Supervisors, she blocked a petrochemical plant near Tucson, opposed a highway threatening public lands, stood up for Tribal sovereignty, and protected thousands of acres of open space. Now, she's running for Congress to continue this critical work, and for her, this fight is deeply personal. Adelita is running to fill the seat held by her late father, Congressman Raúl Grijalva, who was one of our most vocal champions for environmental and social justice. In this moment when our environment and democracy face unprecedented threats, Adelita is carrying forward his legacy and bringing her own experience to the fight. But here's the reality: Special elections are often decided by just a handful of votes, and primary elections can be even closer. subject: Should foreign citizens bankroll American elections?
body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj2053z42vxtxfj821qulwbn4cg4iyonve70ilteye2urn4toqzkhi01iuytppp9mszh9vsaopq64vv9ugqxo&__stmp=sy0g1f&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jf9d6l88zq2pu784ac169enevc225tfa9pe1vkwbwi8adxi4bt3i5pdtw47cerf7ceoykanwr72k24rh4i2ffxzrvm9z1czjx7behu5c78ob3flq5bvb6rmogaoe7q34uf9alxw6rpteoqgfmn16&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jf9d6l88zq2pu784ac169enefp4up9dv1mlt94kod8gvxiy2rad2nj7lczns9189ybqkl7drtgj9q85bk16bs7j6872xkakjtkwzc06ovaq7qdax7yznfqiyvxyba7yah2l1e276mr7tg3k47lta&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy0g1f&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Happy Dairy Month, Peter! My team and I have been at dairy breakfasts across western Wisconsin, celebrating our agricultural heritage and talking about how we can expand opportunities for our farmers instead of "just getting by". [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109761232/552155992/-2087246159?refcode=em-6.17.25-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDY0NDFkMi1hMjRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ib0jjTtZtlyFffw6tzmyQkfEsc9S6rTqBb0z_0DRFu0=) Peter, I know how important it is for our community’s way of life for Congress to have a functioning plan for our ag community. I grew up on a farm, bustling with Holsteins and hired hands. My family has had a farm in this district for 150 years. When we had to sell our cows because of the price of milk and competition with larger dairies, it wasn’t just losing a business, but part of our identity and way of life. And our family was not alone – Wisconsin has lost _30 percent_ of its dairy farms in just five years. **What has Derrick Van Orden done about this? Nothing.** Congress has failed to pass a farm bill which has weakened the ag safety net. The bill needs to be modernized from its 2018 version to adjust for inflation and renew price support programs. On top of the farm bill, the administration's cuts to USAID and the impact of tariffs are hurting farmers' ability to make a profit on their crops – Van Orden has taken no action. **That’s why, together, we must replace him.** [**Working Wisconsinites deserve leadership that reflects them, and together we can make that happen. As we face a critical FEC deadline, please donate $3 to help us flip this seat.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109761233/552155993/-2087246159?refcode=em-6.17.25-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDY0NDFkMi1hMjRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ib0jjTtZtlyFffw6tzmyQkfEsc9S6rTqBb0z_0DRFu0=) __If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: __ | | | ****[Chip in $10 Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109761235/552155994/-2087246159?refcode=em-6.17.25-all-c&express_lane=true&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDY0NDFkMi1hMjRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ib0jjTtZtlyFffw6tzmyQkfEsc9S6rTqBb0z_0DRFu0=)****

Celebrate progress and stand up against anti-LGBTQ+ attacks.
Happy Pride! This month is a bold and bright celebration of love, identity and how far we’ve come — **and it’s a powerful reminder of how strong we are when we stand together.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109762087/552159122/1781302200?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2025.06.17_Pride-Month_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjRhYzllYS1hNDRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nea7H9TSTUT26_MJlsFi9aEc9otzPMp7l8natzfEbeE=) Pride began as a protest. At Stonewall in 1969, brave LGBTQ+ people risked their safety and lives to demand dignity and freedom. Their courage lit a fire that still fuels crucial movements to this day. But, right now, we’re facing a _tremendous_ challenge. Already in 2025, 593 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced or passed nationwide. From attacks on LGBTQ+ kids to threats against marriage equality, the far-right wants to roll back all of our hard-won rights. Unfortunately, under a second Trump administration, those attacks are escalating. I’ve spent many years fighting for LGBTQ+ rights, and I’m honored to stand with this community every step of the way. But if we want to keep up this fight, we need more leaders who believe in real equality and justice for all. **[That’s where you come in: Will you chip in $5 or more today to help amplify bold, pro-equality Democrats across the country this Pride Month?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109762088/552159132/1781302200?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2025.06.17_Pride-Month_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjRhYzllYS1hNDRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nea7H9TSTUT26_MJlsFi9aEc9otzPMp7l8natzfEbeE=)** | | [DONATE NOW >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109762089/552159133/1781302200?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2025.06.17_Pride-Month_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjRhYzllYS1hNDRiLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nea7H9TSTUT26_MJlsFi9aEc9otzPMp7l8natzfEbeE=)

name: Steve Simon
subject: Honoring my friend Melissa
disclaimer_text: paid for by Simon for Secretary of State Committee
body:
| This is the darkest of days for Minnesota, as we all seek to recover from an ugly rampage of politically targeted violence and murder. It’s an unspeakably sad time for the Hortman and Hoffman families, and for our democracy. Melissa Hortman was my good friend. We went to law school together. We were elected the same year to the Minnesota House of Representatives, where we collaborated closely on many issues for many years. She and her husband Mark attended my wedding. I’m just numb about their deaths. I pray for their children, parents, and family. Their assassination is not just a personal loss, but a loss to Minnesota. Melissa Hortman was the best of us. She was one of the most extraordinary public servants I’ve ever known. She was smart, savvy, strategic, kind, funny, brave, and determined. There will never be another leader like her. I pray also for Senator John and Yvette Hoffman, both of whom are friends. May they recover quickly and fully from their devastating injuries. There’s another victim of today’s senseless shootings: Democracy itself. Political violence is unacceptable. To perpetrate it, encourage it, or pretend to ignore it will only poison our democracy. We cannot go on like this as a state or nation. We must re-commit to resolving our political differences peacefully, lawfully, and ultimately through the ballot box. Steve PS: I spoke about this terrible loss on MSNBC. Hi friend, it’s Congresswoman Sarah McBride.
Right now, the GOP is using LGBTQ+ people as pawns. They’re not offering solutions to make everyone's lives better. Instead, they’re busy launching attacks — on our rights and yes, on me.
**As the first openly trans member of Congress, I knew there would be moments like this. But I didn’t run for Congress to debate which bathroom I use or entertain cruelty from my Republican colleagues.**
I ran to deliver for working families. To fight for paid leave. To protect our freedoms. And I will never stop defending the LGBTQ+ community from attacks, manufactured distractions, and the hostility too many of us endure every day.
I won’t let the GOP’s pettiness and bullying derail my work. Has it been easy? No. These fights never are. But I’ve never felt alone — because I have people like you and NV Dems standing with me.
**[_If I can count on your support this Pride Month, split a donation of $3 or whatever you can between my campaign and NV Dems today. Growing up, I couldn’t imagine a future like mine. I wasn’t sure this country’s heart was big enough to love someone like me.
Over the last decade, though, I’ve been able to bear witness to change that once seemed so impossible to me as a kid that it was almost incomprehensible. **Because people believed it could. Because we fought for it.**
That’s what Pride means to me. It's a call to action and a reminder that even in the face of hate, we have the power to fight back with love, with truth, and with unshakable resolve.
